title_en: Would Alaska-Hawaiian 12-Year Widebody Captains Really Earn $493.41 An Hour Under The Tentative Pilot Contract?
title_zh: 根据暂定飞行员合同，阿拉斯加-夏威夷 12 年宽体机长真的能挣到 493.41 美元每小时吗？
summary: Breaking down the pay bump coming for long-haul air crew in Honolulu.
summary_zh: 打破檀香山长途机组人员的薪资上涨。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

After more than 600 days of negotiations, Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines came to a tentative Joint Collective Bargaining Agreement with the Air Line Pilots Association International (ALPA). The terms now dictate that a 12-year widebody captain will earn an eye-popping base rate of $493.41 an hour starting in early 2027. Most mainline airline pilots credit between 800 and 1,000 flight hours per year, meaning a $493.41 rate translates to roughly $395,000 to $493,000 in base flight pay.

That rate is only the starting point for 2027 and is scheduled to rise annually, reaching $539.16 per hour by 2030, according to Aero Crew News . The Black Box Aviation Podcast reported that rates will be adjusted annually to match the average of American, Delta, Southwest, and United on comparable aircraft, or increase by at least 3%, whichever is greater. Alaska Air Group will also contribute 18% directly to 401(k) accounts, alongside a performance-based program with 5% annual payouts.

The terms ALPA agreed to on November 10 will be put to a vote on December 1 for the 4,600 union members to collectively ratify, according to Airline Geeks . If approved, the new pay scales take effect on January 31, 2027. The new contract represents an immediate raise from $86.41 to $102.41 per hour, or a 21.2% to 26.2% pay bump.

The agreement is a long-awaited resolution following Alaska Air Group’s $1.9 billion acquisition of Hawaiian in September 2024. While the Federal Aviation Administration approved the financial merger and granted a single operating certificate in October 2025, aircrews remained divided. Formal joint negotiations launched in February 2025, aiming not only to set uniform pay rates but also to establish an operational framework to reorganize the pilots and jets of the combined fleet.

ALPA negotiators built the new agreement on Alaska’s existing contract framework while preserving legacy Hawaiian protections. Until the unified labor contract is official, management cannot freely assign pilots across both of the newly combined networks or readily swap aircraft to new airfields based on changing demand.
Captain Drew Coyle, the Alaska Airlines MEC chair, commented on the negotiations.

“Our Joint Negotiating Committee remained focused on the priorities of both pilot groups while working through some of the most complex issues facing our combined membership. Nothing about this process was easy. Now it’s our pilots’ turn to review the agreement, ask the tough questions, and decide whether it meets their expectations.”

The tentative agreement also clears a major labor hurdle to Alaska’s long-haul expansion and Hawaiian's $600 million modernization plan. Alaska is expecting up to 17 new Boeing 787 Dreamliners that will launch 12 new overseas routes. Meanwhile, Hawaiian’s fleet overhaul in Honolulu will retrofit all 24 Airbus A330-200 widebodies with new Leihōkū lie-flat suites and premium economy cabins. Still, flying two dozen midlife A330s alongside new 787s forces the airline to maintain separate supply chains, training programs, and maintenance programs.

Passing this contract is only half the battle because Alaska and Hawaiian pilots still cannot fly each other's jets until their seniority lists merge. Under federal law, a neutral arbitrator must combine both pilot rosters into a single master list. Because seniority controls everything from captain upgrades to holiday schedules, pilots must stay separated on their legacy fleets until that process finishes.

Before seniority talks even wrap up, all 4,600 member pilots must approve the four-year agreement itself. Union voting runs from December 1 through December 22. If a majority votes yes, the new pay rates and scheduling rules officially take effect on January 31, 2027, locking in labor stability through January 30, 2031, while eliminating the old pay gap between both workforces.
Captain Larry Payne, the Hawaiian Airlines MEC chair, also remarked on the agreement.

“This joint collective bargaining agreement represents an important milestone for both pilot groups. The decisions made throughout these negotiations will shape our pilots’ careers and quality of life for years to come. If approved, this agreement will establish the foundation for future contracts as we move forward together as one pilot group.”

Once seniority lists finally combine, Alaska Air Group can unleash the full scheduling flexibility it bought with the merger. Management will be able to shift crews seamlessly between Hawaii's refreshed narrowbodies and Seattle's growing Dreamliner fleet as seasonal travel shifts. That operational freedom was impossible after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) granted a single operating certificate in October 2025, merging safety rules but leaving cockpits divided.

Ultimately, locking in $493.41 an hour for widebody captains proves Alaska is serious about competing alongside major legacy airlines on global routes. Yet paying top-tier wages across both fleets raises the stakes for every flight across the Pacific. The carrier's long-term financial success now hinges on whether it can fill those upgraded cabins at profitable fares against tough domestic and international rivals.
Dividing Widebody Routes Between Seattle And Honolulu

As part of the merger, Alaska took over Hawaiian's 787 Dreamliner orders and rebranded its existing 787s to construct an international gateway at its historic Seattle-Tacoma International (SEA) base. To make the increased $493.41 widebody pay rate financially viable, Alaska is dividing its twin-aisle jets across the combined fleet's two unique hubs. Thus, Hawaiian maintains its legacy A330-200s in Honolulu to meet established island leisure and regional Pacific demand.

Hawaiian originally sought the 787-9 in 2018 to upgrade its fleet and increase capacity on long-haul Pacific routes. Hawaiian even canceled a prior order for six A330neos because the Dreamliner had superior fuel efficiency, longer range, and more business-class seating in densely populated markets such as Tokyo and New York. Hawaiian eventually increased its commitment to 12 Dreamliners before merging with Alaska.

Alaska now has widebody jets, experienced pilots, and foreign operating certificates, which it lacked as a primarily narrowbody airline before acquiring Hawaiian. From Seattle, Alaska deploys the 787-9 on ultra-long, high-demand routes to Tokyo Narita, Seoul, London, Rome, Paris, and Athens. The Dreamliner’s range and fuel efficiency are an ideal fit for these business and luxury travel corridors where higher ticket prices offset premium pilot wages.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。

经过 600 多天的谈判，阿拉斯加航空公司和夏威夷航空公司与国际航空公司飞行员协会 (ALPA) 达成了一项暂定联合集体谈判协议。现在的条款规定，从 2027 年初开始，一名 12 年宽体机长的基本工资将达到令人瞠目结舌的每小时 493.41 美元。大多数干线航空公司飞行员每年的飞行时间在 800 到 1,000 小时之间，这意味着 493.41 美元的工资大约相当于 395,000 美元到 493,000 美元的基本飞行工资。

据 Aero Crew News 报道，这一费率只是 2027 年的起点，预计每年都会上涨，到 2030 年达到每小时 539.16 美元。 Black Box Aviation Podcast 报道称，费率将每年进行调整，以符合美国航空、达美航空、西南航空和联合航空同类飞机的平均水平，或增加至少 3%，以较高者为准。阿拉斯加航空集团还将直接向 401(k) 账户捐款 18%，同时还会实施基于绩效的计划，每年支付 5%。
据 Airline Geeks 报道，ALPA 于 11 月 10 日达成的条款将于 12 月 1 日进行投票，供 4,600 名工会成员集体批准。如果获得批准，新的薪资标准将于 2027 年 1 月 31 日生效。新合同意味着薪资立即从每小时 86.41 美元上涨至 102.41 美元，即薪资上涨 21.2% 至 26.2%。
该协议是阿拉斯加航空集团于 2024 年 9 月以 19 亿美元收购夏威夷航空后达成的一项期待已久的决议。虽然美国联邦航空管理局于 2025 年 10 月批准了财务合并并授予了单一运营证书，但机组人员仍然存在分歧。正式联合谈判于 2025 年 2 月启动，不仅旨在制定统一的薪资标准，还旨在建立重组联合机队飞行员和飞机的运营框架。
ALPA 谈判代表在阿拉斯加现有合同框架的基础上达成了新协议，同时保留了夏威夷的传统保护措施。在统一劳动合同正式生效之前，管理层无法在两个新合并的网络之间自由分配飞行员，也无法根据不断变化的需求轻松将飞机更换到新机场。
阿拉斯加航空 MEC 主席德鲁·科伊尔 (Drew Coyle) 机长对谈判发表了评论。
“我们的联合谈判委员会仍然专注于两个试点小组的优先事项，同时解决我们联合成员所面临的一些最复杂的问题。这个过程并不容易。现在轮到我们的试点审查协议，提出棘手的问题，并决定它是否符合他们的期望。”

该暂定协议还清除了阿拉斯加长途航线扩张和夏威夷航空 6 亿美元现代化计划的主要劳动力障碍。阿拉斯加预计将有多达 17 架全新波音 787 梦想飞机开通 12 条新的海外航线。与此同时，夏威夷航空在檀香山的机队大修将为所有 24 架空客 A330-200 宽体客机进行改装，配备新的 Leihōkū 平躺套房和高级经济舱。尽管如此，将两打中期 A330 飞机与新型 787 飞机一起飞行，迫使该航空公司维持独立的供应链、培训计划和维护计划。
通过这份合同只是成功的一半，因为阿拉斯加和夏威夷飞行员在资历合并之前仍然无法驾驶对方的飞机。根据联邦法律，中立仲裁员必须将两个飞行员名册合并为一个主名单。由于资历控制着从机长升级到假期安排的一切，飞行员必须在其遗留机队中保持分离，直到该过程完成。
在资历谈判结束之前，所有 4,600 名飞行员成员都必须批准这份为期四年的协议。工会投票从12月1日持续到12月22日。如果多数人投赞成票，新的工资率和排班规则将于2027年1月31日正式生效，锁定劳动力稳定至2031年1月30日，同时消除双方劳动力之间旧有的工资差距。
夏威夷航空 MEC 主席拉里·佩恩机长也对该协议发表了评论。
“这项联合集体谈判协议对两个试点小组来说都是一个重要的里程碑。在这些谈判过程中做出的决定将影响我们飞行员未来几年的职业生涯和生活质量。如果获得批准，这项协议将为未来的合同奠定基础，让我们作为一个试点小组共同前进。”
一旦资历列表最终合并，阿拉斯加航空集团就可以充分释放通过合并获得的调度灵活性。随着季节性旅行的变化，管理层将能够在夏威夷更新的窄体客机和西雅图不断壮大的梦想飞机机队之间无缝调动机组人员。在美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 于 2025 年 10 月授予单一运营证书、合并安全规则但驾驶舱分开后，这种运营自由就变得不可能了。
最终，为宽体机机长锁定每小时 493.41 美元的收入证明阿拉斯加认真地在全球航线上与主要传统航空公司竞争。然而，向两个机队支付最高工资会增加每一次飞越太平洋航班的风险。该航空公司的长期财务成功现在取决于它能否以有利可图的票价来容纳这些升级后的客舱，以对抗强大的国内和国际竞争对手。
西雅图和檀香山之间的宽体客机航线划分

作为合并的一部分，阿拉斯加接管了夏威夷航空的 787 梦想飞机订单，并重新命名了其现有 787 飞机，以便在其历史悠久的西雅图-塔科马国际 (SEA) 基地建造一座国际门户。为了使增加的 493.41 美元宽体机工资率在财务上可行，阿拉斯加将其双通道喷气式飞机分布在联合机队的两个独特的枢纽上。 Thus, Hawaiian maintains its legacy A330-200s in Honolulu to meet established island leisure and regional Pacific demand.
夏威夷航空最初于 2018 年寻求 787-9 飞机，以升级其机队并增加长途太平洋航线的运力。夏威夷航空甚至取消了之前的 6 架 A330neo 订单，因为梦想客机具有卓越的燃油效率、更远的航程以及在东京和纽约等人口稠密的市场中拥有更多商务舱座位的能力。在与阿拉斯加合并之前，夏威夷航空最终增加了对 12 架梦想飞机的承诺。
阿拉斯加现在拥有宽体喷气式飞机、经验丰富的飞行员和外国运营证书，这是在收购夏威夷航空之前作为主要窄体航空公司所缺乏的。从阿拉斯加西雅图出发，在超长、高需求航线上部署 787-9，飞往东京成田、首尔、伦敦、罗马、巴黎和雅典。梦想飞机的航程和燃油效率非常适合这些商务和豪华旅行走廊，这些走廊的票价较高，抵消了飞行员的高薪。

body_en: Three killed in Piper Comanche crash at Grand Canyon - Aviation24.be

Three people died when a Piper PA-24 Comanche registered N7217P crashed near the North Rim of Arizona’s Grand Canyon on 15 November 2026, according to US authorities. The FAA said the accident occurred at around 19:15 local time.

The Grand Canyon Regional Communications Center received a missing-aircraft report at approximately 23:30 that evening. Search teams focused on the Basin area, the aircraft’s last known location, with the Arizona Department of Public Safety using infrared equipment and night vision during an overnight aerial search.

The wreckage and debris field were located at about 10:15 on 16 November. The National Park Service confirmed there were no survivors and withheld the occupants’ names out of respect for their families.

The National Transportation Safety Board is investigating. It described the crash site as mountainous terrain and said the wreckage would be documented before being recovered for further examination. The cause has yet to be determined.

据美国当局称，2026 年 11 月 15 日，一架注册为 N7217P 的派珀 PA-24 科曼奇飞机在亚利桑那州大峡谷北缘附近坠毁，造成 3 人死亡。美国联邦航空局表示，事故发生在当地时间19点15分左右。
当晚 23 点 30 分左右，大峡谷地区通讯中心收到了飞机失踪报告。搜索小组将重点放在盆地地区，即飞机最后已知的位置，亚利桑那州公共安全部在夜间空中搜索中使用红外设备和夜视仪。
11 月 16 日上午 10 点 15 分左右，找到了飞机残骸和碎片场。国家公园管理局确认没有幸存者，并出于对家人的尊重而隐瞒了居住者的姓名。
美国国家运输安全委员会正在调查。它将坠机地点描述为山区，并表示在打捞残骸以供进一步检查之前将对其进行记录。原因尚未确定。

title_en: FAA orders Boeing 737NG checks over loss-of-control risk
title_zh: FAA 下令波音 737NG 检查失控风险
summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has ordered repeated checks on certain Boeing 737 Next Generation aircraft after… The post FAA orders Boeing 737NG checks over loss-of-control risk appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 已下令对某些下一代波音 737 飞机进行重复检查……
body_en: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has ordered repeated checks on certain Boeing 737 Next Generation aircraft after identifying a fault that could prevent an autothrottle safety system from responding to unequal engine thrust, potentially leading to a loss of control.
The airworthiness directive (AD) covers an estimated 300 US-registered aircraft. It is scheduled for publication on November 20, 2026, and takes effect 15 days later.

The problem involves missing or incorrect spoiler-position data used by the autothrottle’s cruise thrust split monitor. Without reliable data, the monitor could fail to activate, allowing a large difference in engine thrust to develop without the autothrottle disengaging.
That could cause the aircraft to roll unexpectedly. If pilots do not recognize and correct the condition promptly, they could lose control, the FAA said.

The agency bypassed the normal advance public-comment process, citing the safety risk. Operators must perform recurring built-in tests of the digital flight control system, correct failures and repeat testing until the system passes.
The directive, AD 2026-23-04, applies to specified 737-600, -700, -700C, -800 and -900 aircraft. It does not cover the 737 MAX.
The FAA addressed a similar concern on older 737 Classic aircraft in October 2022, when it ordered repeated tests on certain 737-300, -400 and -500 models.

In that directive, the agency said a failed spoiler sensor could go undetected by the autothrottle computer. A review found that maintenance testing was needed to identify failures involving the sensor input or its wiring.

The necessary test already appeared in the aircraft maintenance manual, but operators were not required to perform it repeatedly. The 2022 rule made recurring testing mandatory to prevent a failure from remaining undetected.

body_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 在发现可能阻止自动油门安全系统响应不均匀的发动机推力并可能导致失控的故障后，已下令对某些下一代波音 737 飞机进行重复检查。
适航指令 (AD) 涵盖约 300 架在美国注册的飞机。计划于2026年11月20日发布，15天后生效。
该问题涉及自动油门巡航推力分离监视器使用的扰流板位置数据丢失或不正确。如果没有可靠的数据，监视器可能无法启动，从而导致发动机推力产生巨大差异而自动油门不脱离。
这可能会导致飞机意外滚动。美国联邦航空局表示，如果飞行员不能及时识别并纠正这种情况，他们可能会失去控制。
该机构以存在安全风险为由，绕过了正常的预先公众意见征询程序。操作员必须对数字飞行控制系统进行重复的内置测试，纠正故障并重复测试，直到系统通过。
美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 于 2022 年 10 月对旧型 737 Classic 飞机提出了类似的担忧，当时它下令对某些 737-300、-400 和 -500 型号进行重复测试。
在该指令中，该机构表示，自动油门计算机可能无法检测到出现故障的扰流板传感器。审查发现需要进行维护测试来识别涉及传感器输入或其接线的故障。
必要的测试已经出现在飞机维护手册中，但操作员不需要重复执行。 2022 年规则强制要求进行定期测试，以防止故障未被发现。
