title_en: American Airlines Airbus A319 Pilots Declare Mayday After SkyWest Crew Spot Engine Flames
title_zh: 美国航空空客 A319 飞行员在 SkyWest 机组人员发现发动机起火后宣布求救
summary: Pilots declared mayday after hydraulic alerts and engine fire reports, landing safely then grounded for inspection.
summary_zh: 飞行员在收到液压警报和发动机起火报告后宣布求救，安全着陆然后接地接受检查。
body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

An American Airlines flight, an Airbus A319 departing from Phoenix (PHX) declared Mayday shortly after takeoff after another aircraft spotted flames in one of the Airbus' engines. This led the crew of a trailing SkyWest-operated flight to warn air traffic control of the warning, and as a result, the plane returned to Phoenix.
American flight 3230 was a scheduled service departing from Phoenix to Portland (PDX). The flight promptly returned to Phoenix as the incident was unfolding.
Mayday, Mayday, Mayday: AA3230 Returns To Phoenix

The pilots on board the American service bound for Portland had initially confirmed to air traffic control that the aircraft experienced hydraulic problems shortly after departure, and as a result, the flight would need to return to Phoenix.

Moments after, as reported by Flightdrama , the crew then came across the radio declaring ' Mayday, Mayday, Mayday ' and requesting vectors to return to Phoenix (a specific compass heading which is assigned by local air traffic control (ATC) that assists in guiding a pilot's flight path using surveillance data like radar).
Simple Flying reached out to American for comment on the flight, and promptly received the below response from an airline spokesperson

American Airlines flight 3230 returned to Phoenix (PHX) due to a mechanical issue. The aircraft landed safely, taxiied to the gate under its own power and was taken out of service to be inspected by our maintenance team. Customers deplaned normally and will re-depart this evening on a new aircraft. Safety is our top priority and we thank our team members for their professionalism and apologize to our customers for the disruption in their travel plans.
Flames Coming From The Engine On American A319 Carrying 120 Onboard

As the crew declared Mayday, air traffic controllers asked a series of questions to the flight crew, including whether the plane needed to burn off excess fuel. The pilots confirmed that 120 people were onboard. A review of flight data from the Simple Flying Flight Tracker identifies the following movements of the aircraft

AA3230 was a scheduled daily service to Oregon , with the flight to Portland expected to depart at 3:58 PM. The service was shortly delayed and eventually pushed back from the gate at Phoenix at 4:14 PM, 16 minutes behind schedule. Taking off from the Arizona airport in a westerly direction, the jet spent just a total of 20 minutes in the air before touching down safely in Phoenix at 4:34 PM.

Upon arrival in Phoenix, the plane was able to land safely and taxi to the gate without assistance. The plane has since been removed from service, and the passengers were deplaned normally and were rebooked onto a replacement service later this evening that departed at 5:45 PM and arrived in Portland at 7:54 PM local time.

The jet at the centre of the incident was N703UW. The 28-year-old A319-112 carries serial number 904 and was initially delivered to US Airways in 1998, before being transferred into the American fleet, following the airline's merger in 2013. The aircraft is configured with up to 132 seats in a two-class layout (including Domestic First and Main Cabin). Full details below as per ch-aviation

Following the recent incident on the flight departing Phoenix, the aircraft remains grounded while further inspections are undertaken by the carrier's maintenance teams. The quick actions by the crew onboard, and thanks to the quick spotting by the following SkyWest service, helped relay vital information to air traffic control on the unfolding situation in Phoenix.

The crew onboard flight 3230 took rapid action with clear coordination to establish the critical emergency details early, allowing ground and air teams to coordinate without delay and ensure the prompt return of the aircraft to the ground and the safety of all occupants onboard.
body_zh: 记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
美国航空 (American Airlines) 一架从菲尼克斯 (PHX) 起飞的空客 A319 航班在起飞后不久宣布求救，原因是另一架飞机发现空客的一个发动机起火。这导致 SkyWest 运营的一架尾随航班的机组人员向空中交通管制部门发出警告，结果飞机返回凤凰城。
美国航空 3230 号航班是从菲尼克斯飞往波特兰 (PDX) 的定期航班。事件发生后，该航班立即返回凤凰城。
五月天，五月天，五月天：AA3230返回凤凰城
飞往波特兰的美国航班上的飞行员最初向空中交通管制部门确认，飞机在起飞后不久就出现了液压问题，因此航班需要返回菲尼克斯。
据 Flightdrama 报道，不久之后，机组人员听到广播中喊着“求救，求救，求救”，并请求引导返回凤凰城（当地空中交通管制 (ATC) 指定的特定罗盘航向，可使用雷达等监视数据协助引导飞行员的飞行路径）。
Simple Flying 联系美国航空征求对该航班的评论，并立即收到了航空公司发言人的以下回复
美国航空 3230 航班因机械问题返回菲尼克斯 (PHX)。飞机安全着陆，依靠自身动力滑行至登机口，并退出服务接受我们维修团队的检查。乘客正常下机，将于今晚搭乘新飞机重新出发。安全是我们的首要任务，我们感谢团队成员的专业精神，并就我们的客户旅行计划的中断向他们表示歉意。
载有 120 人的美国 A319 发动机起火
当机组人员宣布“求救”时，空中交通管制员向机组人员询问了一系列问题，包括飞机是否需要燃烧掉多余的燃油。飞行员证实机上有120人。对简单飞行跟踪器的飞行数据进行审查后，确定了飞机的以下运动
AA3230 是飞往俄勒冈州的每日定期航班，飞往波特兰的航班预计于下午 3:58 起飞。该航班很快被延误，并最终于下午 4 点 14 分从凤凰城登机口推迟，比原计划晚了 16 分钟。这架飞机从亚利桑那州机场向西起飞，总共只在空中飞行了 20 分钟，然后于下午 4:34 安全降落在凤凰城。
抵达凤凰城后，飞机在没有任何帮助的情况下安全着陆并滑行至登机口。此后，这架飞机已停止服务，乘客正常下机，并重新预订了今晚晚些时候的替代航班，该航班于下午 5:45 出发，于当地时间晚上 7:54 抵达波特兰。
事件中心的飞机是 N703UW。这架已有 28 年历史的 A319-112 序列号为 904，最初于 1998 年交付给全美航空，2013 年该航空公司合并后转入美国航空机队。该飞机采用两舱布局（包括国内头等舱和经济舱），最多可容纳 132 个座位。以下为 ch-aviation 的完整详细信息
在最近从菲尼克斯起飞的航班发生事件后，该飞机仍处于停飞状态，同时航空公司的维护团队正在进行进一步检查。机上机组人员的快速行动，以及随后 SkyWest 服务的快速发现，帮助向空中交通管制部门传达了有关凤凰城局势发展的重要信息。
3230航班机组人员迅速行动，协调明确，尽早确定关键应急细节，让地面和空中团队及时协调，确保飞机迅速返回地面和机上所有乘客的安全。

title_en: Why The GCAP Is The Only 6th-Generation Fighter Jet The Rest Of The World Can Actually Buy
title_zh: 为什么 GCAP 是世界其他地区唯一可以实际购买的第六代战斗机
summary: The GCAP/Tempest is shaping up to be the most prominent sixth-gen fighter jet set to take over the future export market for that class of aircraft.
summary_zh: GCAP/Tempest 正在成为最著名的第六代战斗机，将占领该级别飞机的未来出口市场。
body_en: Aaron is an aviation enthusiast and world traveler with a deep interest in aerospace history and technology. He has traveled around the world numerous times, often incorporating visits to aviation museums and historic aircraft collections into his journeys. A native of New Zealand, he is an expert in aviation and maintains a broad interest in a variety of other subjects.

In June 2026, Germany announced it was withdrawing from the FCAS 6th-generation fighter jet project with France and Spain. This left the GCAP/Tempest as the only credible European-led sixth-generation fighter jet program. The GCAP intends to be a reasonably heavy sixth-generation air superiority fighter jet built with an emphasis on multirole missions.

It is also being designed explicitly with an eye to exports. Developing a true sixth-generation fighter jet that functions as part of a fully integrated networked kill chain is now so complicated and so expensive that it can strain any nation's aerospace industry to the breaking point (with the possible exceptions of the US and China).

Even so, there is discussion in Washington over whether the US aerospace industry has the bandwidth to develop two next-generation fighters side by side. Some advocate delaying the F/A-XX until after the F-47 is more developed.

Fighter jet purchases are high-profile political affairs that can become politically heated quickly. This is often seen in South America and now in Canada, on the topic of purchasing US fighter jets (vs Swedish Gripens). Many countries do not wish to purchase US fighter jets for geopolitical reasons.

Indonesia is an extreme example of a country exploring purchasing fighter jets from half a dozen countries to ensure no country has too much control over its fighter jet fleet (through spare parts and software updates). It has indicated that Turkish KAAN fighters would need to be free from US ITAR restrictions, a very tall ask.

A range of factors, from Russia's annexation of Crimea in 2014 to the passage of CAASTA in 2017 to the sanctions of 2022 , have contributed to Russia's fighter jet export market collapsing. It has become infeasible for dozens of countries, including all NATO member Eastern European countries, to purchase Russian fighters.

Indeed, Serbia said it was infeasible to purchase Russian fighters and so opted for French Rafales. Elsewhere, China is emerging on the stage as a serious export market for higher-end fighter jets. However, while some countries like Egypt, the UAE, and Argentina have openly touted purchasing Chinese fighters, only Pakistan has done so (J-10Cs and possibly upcoming J-35s).

Many African countries and others have purchased lower-end Chinese fighters or advanced trainers. For many countries, purchasing Chinese fighters remains geopolitically complicated and is out of the question for non-aligned countries like Vietnam and India.

Being developed by the UK, Italy, and Japan, the GCAP offers an alternative to the US, China, and Russia that can be more geopolitically salient for many countries. This is somewhat similar to how Canadians are currently viewing the Saab Gripen. It's not an 'enemy' Chinese or Russian fighter, but it's not fully American either.

Australia, Saudi Arabia, and India have expressed interest in GCAP and the collapse of FCAS has reduced their options. It has also opened the door to the possibility of Germany (and possibly Spain) joining the program in some capacity. It would be a major boon for the GCAP if Germany were to join, as the trio (and particularly the UK) is currently struggling with financing the ambitious program by itself.

Another important aspect is that any country can market its fighter jet as whatever generation they like. Pakistan has promoted later JF-17 variants, particularly the Block III, as possessing capabilities associated with 4.5-generation fighters (sometimes 4.5 'plus'). Sukhoi's marketing suggested its proposed Su-75 Checkmate low-cost fighter would be a fifth-generation fighter rivaling the F-35.

Fighter jet generation labels are part marketing, part clickbait, and part useful. The engineering of a next-generation aircraft is less about visible features (such as tailless vs large vertical stabilizers) and more about internal features (thermal management, sensor fusion, and networking).

Without Germany, serious analysts do not think France will have the capacity to develop a fully-fledged sixth-generation fighter jet alone. France's Dassault has said it plans to go it alone and develop a next-generation fighter, although analysts expect this to be a lighter-weight, less ambitious carrier-based aircraft and closer to something like a fifth-generation 'plus' fighter.

Perhaps a more important question is what Germany will do. Germany could partner with Sweden (and/or Spain) and develop a sixth-generation fighter jet that could compete with the GCAP. Even if it does, the GCAP has a head start, although such a jet could compete with GCAP sometime in the 2040s .

Germany could throw its weight behind the GCAP, or another option could be for it to purchase more F-35s and focus on developing advanced teaming combat drones. Other programs, like South Korea's KF-21 and Turkey's KAAN fighter jet, are 4.5-generation fighter jets with low-observable characteristics.

These countries have plans to introduce later block upgrades to make them closer to fifth-generation jets. But they are not likely to compete in the GCAP's segment directly. Sweden could theoretically go it alone and develop a next-generation successor to the Saab Gripen, but it would likely be much less ambitious than the GCAP.

For now, the primary advanced frontline fighter jet the US offers on the export market is the F-35. In practice, in the late 2030s and 2040s, it could be a future F-35 Block 5 that will be the primary export competitor to the GCAP, although this is somewhat speculative. A future F-35 Block 5 could be a fifth-generation 'plus' fighter or thought of as a fifth-generation fighter with sixth-generation characteristics.

The primary 6th-generation jet the US is developing is the F-47 . This is intended as the tip of the spear air dominance fighter. Its niche role is seen in how few the Air Force states it wants to purchase (185+), around a tenth of its program of record for the F-35A. The F-47 is designed to replace the F-22 and complement the F-35.

Importantly, it is designed for USAF requirements without much regard for export air force requirements (unlike the GCAP and the F-35). In March 2025, US President Donald Trump said a downgraded version of the F-47 would be available for export, although this is not his Administration's decision to make.
body_zh: 亚伦是一位航空爱好者和环球旅行家，对航空航天历史和技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他曾多次环游世界，经常在旅途中参观航空博物馆和历史飞机收藏。他是新西兰人，是航空专家，并对其他各种学科保持着广泛的兴趣。
2026年6月，德国宣布退出与法国和西班牙合作的FCAS第六代战斗机项目。这使得 GCAP/Tempest 成为欧洲主导的唯一可信的第六代战斗机项目。 GCAP 旨在成为一款相当重型的第六代空中优势战斗机，重点是执行多用途任务。
它的设计也明确着眼于出口。开发真正的第六代战斗机作为完全集成的网络杀伤链的一部分现在是如此复杂和昂贵，以至于它可以将任何国家的航空航天工业推向崩溃点（美国和中国可能除外）。
即便如此，华盛顿仍在讨论美国航空航天工业是否有能力同时开发两架下一代战斗机。一些人主张推迟 F/A-XX 直到 F-47 进一步发展之后。
购买战斗机是备受瞩目的政治事务，可能很快就会在政治上变得激烈。这种情况在南美和现在的加拿大经常出现在购买美国战斗机（与瑞典鹰狮战斗机）的话题上。出于地缘政治原因，许多国家不愿购买美国战斗机。
印度尼西亚是一个极端的例子，该国正在探索从六个国家购买战斗机，以确保没有国家对其战斗机机队拥有过多的控制权（通过备件和软件更新）。它表明土耳其 KAAN 战斗机需要不受美国 ITAR 的限制，这是一个非常高的要求。
从2014年俄罗斯吞并克里米亚，到2017年CAASTA通过，再到2022年的制裁，一系列因素导致俄罗斯战斗机出口市场崩溃。包括所有北约东欧国家在内的数十个国家购买俄罗斯战机已经变得行不通。
事实上，塞尔维亚表示购买俄罗斯战斗机不可行，因此选择了法国阵风战斗机。在其他地方，中国正在成为高端战斗机的重要出口市场。然而，虽然埃及、阿联酋和阿根廷等一些国家公开宣称购买中国战斗机，但只有巴基斯坦这样做了（J-10C 以及可能即将推出的 J-35）。
许多非洲国家和其他国家都购买了中国的低端战斗机或高级教练机。对于许多国家来说，购买中国战斗机仍然是一个复杂的地缘政治问题，对于越南和印度等不结盟国家来说也是不可能的。
GCAP 由英国、意大利和日本制定，为美国、中国和俄罗斯提供了替代方案，对许多国家来说在地缘政治上更为重要。这有点类似于加拿大人目前对萨博鹰狮的看法。它不是中国或俄罗斯的“敌方”战斗机，但也不是完全美国的。
澳大利亚、沙特阿拉伯和印度都表达了对 GCAP 的兴趣，而 FCAS 的崩溃减少了他们的选择。它还为德国（可能还有西班牙）以某种身份加入该计划打开了大门。如果德国加入，这对 GCAP 来说将是一个重大福音，因为这三个国家（尤其是英国）目前正在努力为这一雄心勃勃的计划提供资金。
另一个重要的方面是，任何国家都可以将其战斗机推向他们喜欢的任何一代。巴基斯坦推广了后来的 JF-17 改型，特别是 Block III，因为其拥有与 4.5 代战斗机（有时是 4.5 代战斗机）相关的能力。苏霍伊公司的营销表明，其拟议的 Su-75 Checkmate 低成本战斗机将是与 F-35 相媲美的第五代战斗机。
战斗机一代标签部分是营销，部分是标题诱饵，部分是有用的。下一代飞机的工程设计不再关注可见特征（例如无尾翼与大型垂直稳定器），而是更多关注内部特征（热管理、传感器融合和网络）。
严肃的分析人士认为，如果没有德国，法国将没有能力单独开发成熟的第六代战斗机。法国达索公司表示，计划单独开发下一代战斗机，尽管分析人士预计这将是一种重量更轻、雄心勃勃的舰载机，更接近第五代“+”战斗机。
也许更重要的问题是德国会做什么。德国可以与瑞典（和/或西班牙）合作开发能够与 GCAP 竞争的第六代战斗机。即使确实如此，GCAP 也具有领先优势，尽管这种喷气式飞机可能会在 2040 年代的某个时候与 GCAP 竞争。
德国可以大力支持 GCAP，或者另一种选择是购买更多 F-35 并专注于开发先进的组队作战无人机。其他项目，如韩国的KF-21和土耳其的KAAN战斗机，都是具有低可观测特性的4.5代战斗机。
这些国家计划稍后推出整体升级，使其更接近第五代喷气机。但他们不太可能直接参与 GCAP 的细分市场竞争。理论上，瑞典可以单独开发萨博“鹰狮”的下一代继任者，但它的雄心可能远不如 GCAP 那样雄心勃勃。
目前，美国在出口市场上提供的主要先进前线战斗机是F-35。实际上，在 2030 年代末和 2040 年代，未来的 F-35 Block 5 可能会成为 GCAP 的主要出口竞争对手，尽管这有些推测性。未来的 F-35 Block 5 可能是第五代“plus”战斗机，或者被认为是具有第六代特征的第五代战斗机。
美国正在开发的主要第六代喷气机是 F-47。这是空中优势战斗机的矛尖。它的利基角色可以从空军表示想要购买的数量（185 架以上）中看出，大约是其记录的 F-35A 计划的十分之一。 F-47 旨在取代 F-22 并补充 F-35。
重要的是，它是为美国空军的要求而设计的，而没有过多考虑出口空军的要求（与 GCAP 和 F-35 不同）。 2025 年 3 月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，F-47 的降级版本将可供出口，尽管这不是他的政府的决定。

title_en: Too Fast? United Airlines' Starlink Rollout Is So Rapid, Some Planes Still Have Their Old WiFi Antennas
title_zh: 太快了？联合航空 Starlink 推出速度如此之快，一些飞机仍然保留着旧的 WiFi 天线
summary: United's plan to offer the best onboard WiFi of any US airline.
summary_zh: 美联航计划提供美国航空公司中最好的机上 WiFi。
body_en: Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

United Airlines has been steadily improving its product and customer experience to move upmarket and compete head-on with Delta Air Lines, the premium leader in the US, for years. The carrier has made genuine shifts and has been rewarded with improving financials, to the point that it now regularly posts results nearly as impressive as Delta's. One weak point, however, is that the airline's onboard WiFi systems have lagged behind what competitors offered going into the 2020s.

But in 2024, United announced that it would install Starlink WiFi across its entire mainline and regional fleets, comprising over 1,600 aircraft. It aims to complete Starlink retrofits by the end of 2027, which is an ambitious target given the sheer size of the combined fleet. To achieve this quickly, the airline is rapidly sending aircraft for retrofits, and United has placed such an emphasis on speed that it's installing Starlink on some aircraft without removing their legacy systems.

Starlink , a subsidiary of SpaceX, is a relatively new player in the inflight WiFi market. However, Starlink systems provide much faster onboard connectivity than those offered by companies such as Viasat, Thales, or Panasonic, and the company even formerly mandated that airline customers offer it to passengers for free (this is reportedly no longer the case). As such, it's become extremely popular with passengers, while airlines have been lining up for the service.

United announced Starlink in September 2024, with the roll-out beginning in 2025. It later announced that it aimed to have all mainline and regional aircraft equipped with Starlink by the end of 2027, which meant an extremely rapid roll-out given the sheer size of the fleet. Initially, United focused on retrofitting Starlink onto the United Express fleet, as the service contract for the providers on this fleet was set to end shortly. Soon afterward, Starlink started coming to mainline.

The official United Starlink tracker shows that all Bombardier CRJ550s and Embraer E175s have been completed . 346 narrowbody aircraft have been retrofitted, and United has installed Starlink on the Airbus A321neo, A321XLR, Boeing 737-800, 737-900ER, 737 MAX 8, and 737 MAX 9. In addition, United has now installed Starlink on four 777-200ERs, one 777-300ER, and two 787-8s. Overall, about 46% of the fleet is retrofitted: 705 aircraft out of the 1,632 aircraft flying for United and United Express.

Earlier this month, a United 737-900ER was spotted parked at a gate and shared on X with two Starlink antennas (United's standard configuration for the system) and its older Viasat antenna. Similarly, a 737-900 was also spotted, equipped with Starlink and Viasat antennas, according to an X post.

One advertised benefit of Starlink is quick installation, but it appears the main holdup in the retrofit project is the time required to remove the aircraft's previous WiFi equipment. On some aircraft, the airline simply left it on for now to speed up the process.

United has just over a year remaining until its end-of-2027 deadline, and only 46% of the fleet is completed. There's a high chance that this timeline could slip, but Starlink is meant to be a major commercial advantage for the airline . A clean Starlink installation is advertised as taking as little as eight hours, which is significantly faster than installation times for other WiFi systems. However, the full retrofit also requires removing the previous WiFi system, which can add significantly more time.

United states that its full timeline, including removing the legacy system, is about three to four days. To get the entire fleet retrofitted by the end of 2027, it would need to have a significant number of aircraft out of service, which is lost revenue. Therefore, the carrier has decided to shorten the timeline for N78438 and N37409 by leaving the Viasat system on for the time being, and it remains to be seen whether it will continue this practice in the future.

Starlink is now flying on United's Bombardier and Embraer aircraft, along with the A321neo, 737, 777, and 787. However, it still operates a substantial number of aircraft with older WiFi systems. All the non-Starlink widebodies are equipped with Panasonic systems, while the narrowbody fleet features a mix of Panasonic, Viasat, and Thales systems. While Starlink is offered for free , the other systems generally require payment upfront, and none of the three offers the same speeds as Starlink.

American Airlines generally offers Viasat WiFi on its domestic fleet, which is complimentary for AAdvantage members, while most of the widebodies are equipped with Panasonic systems. Delta offers either Viasat or Hughes WiFi on nearly its entire fleet. The benefit is that Viasat and Hughes offer much faster speeds than Panasonic and Thales. The downside for these airlines is that Starlink offers even faster speeds. But for United, it's now offering the fastest and slowest WiFi systems among its rivals.

United is banking on Starlink becoming a major commercial advantage over its rivals, but it will only be a true advantage once the system is available across United's entire fleet. A better WiFi system on its own is not necessarily a reason for customers to choose one airline over the other, but it's becoming an increasingly important factor in purchasing decisions. As United continues to aim for product and a premium brand, Starlink is becoming increasingly important to the airline's selling proposition.
How Starlink Fits Into United's Commercial Strategy

By moving upmarket and becoming a 'premium' airline brand, United is hoping to be a carrier that wins customers' business based on its name and product. This is the strategy that Delta first implemented under CEO Richard Anderson after its 2008 merger with Northwest Airlines , and Delta is now the most successful airline in the country. But of course, the US carriers don't make their money by selling flight tickets; rather, the money is in loyalty programs.

United offers Starlink for free, but it's only accessible with a MileagePlus account number . A customer who signs up for MileagePlus and accesses Starlink may be more inclined to fly with United in the future. From there, they may be more likely to sign up for a MileagePlus co-branded credit card, which is where the real money is. United and its contemporaries sell huge amounts of miles to their credit card partners at little cost, and it's in the airlines' best interests to increase demand for these miles.
body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
多年来，联合航空一直在稳步改善其产品和客户体验，以进军高端市场并与美国高端航空领导者达美航空正面竞争。该航空公司已经做出了真正的转变，并因财务状况的改善而获得回报，以至于它现在经常公布的业绩几乎与达美航空一样令人印象深刻。然而，该航空公司的一个弱点是，进入 2020 年代，该航空公司的机上 WiFi 系统已经落后于竞争对手所提供的系统。
但在 2024 年，美联航宣布将在其整个干线和支线机队（包括 1,600 多架飞机）安装 Starlink WiFi。它的目标是在 2027 年底前完成星链改造，考虑到联合舰队的庞大规模，这是一个雄心勃勃的目标。为了快速实现这一目标，该航空公司正在迅速派遣飞机进行改装，而美联航非常重视速度，因此在一些飞机上安装了星链，而无需拆除其遗留系统。
Starlink 是 SpaceX 的子公司，是机上 WiFi 市场相对较新的参与者。然而，星链系统提供的机上连接速度比 Viasat、泰雷兹或松下等公司提供的连接速度要快得多，该公司甚至以前要求航空公司客户免费向乘客提供该系统（据报道，现在情况已不再如此）。因此，它非常受乘客欢迎，而航空公司也一直在排队等候这项服务。
美联航于 2024 年 9 月宣布推出 Starlink，并于 2025 年开始推出。随后又宣布，其目标是在 2027 年底前让所有干线和支线飞机都配备 Starlink，考虑到机队规模庞大，这意味着部署速度极快。最初，美联航专注于在联合快运机队上改造星链，因为该机队供应商的服务合同即将到期。不久之后，星链开始进入主线。

官方联合星链追踪器显示，所有庞巴迪 CRJ550 和巴西航空工业公司 E175 均已完工。已改装 346 架窄体飞机，美联航已在空客 A321neo、A321XLR、波音 737-800、737-900ER、737 MAX 8 和 737 MAX 9 上安装了 Starlink。此外，美联航现已在四架 777-200ER、一架 777-300ER 和两架上安装了 Starlink。 787-8s。总体而言，约 46% 的机队进行了改装：美联航和联航快运运营的 1,632 架飞机中，有 705 架飞机进行了改装。
本月早些时候，一架美联航 737-900ER 被发现停在登机口，并在 X 上共享两根 Starlink 天线（美联航系统的标准配置）和旧的 Viasat 天线。据 X 帖子称，类似地，还发现了一架 737-900，配备了 Starlink 和 Viasat 天线。
Starlink 宣传的优点之一是快速安装，但改造项目的主要障碍似乎是拆除飞机上以前的 WiFi 设备所需的时间。在某些飞机上，航空公司只是暂时将其保留以加快流程。
距离 2027 年底的最后期限，美联航只剩下一年多的时间，而机队只完成了 46%。这个时间表很有可能会推迟，但星链计划将为该航空公司带来主要的商业优势。据称，一次干净的 Starlink 安装只需八个小时，这比其他 WiFi 系统的安装时间要快得多。然而，全面改造还需要删除以前的 WiFi 系统，这会显着增加时间。
美国表示，其完整时间表（包括删除遗留系统）大约需要三到四天。为了在 2027 年底之前对整个机队进行改造，需要大量飞机停止使用，这会造成收入损失。因此，该运营商决定缩短N78438和N37409的时间，暂时保留Viasat系统，未来是否会继续这种做法还有待观察。

Starlink 目前在美联航的庞巴迪和巴西航空工业公司飞机以及 A321neo、737、777 和 787 上运行。但是，该公司仍然运营着大量配备较旧 WiFi 系统的飞机。所有非 Starlink 宽体飞机均配备松下系统，而窄体机队则混合使用松下、Viasat 和泰雷兹系统。虽然 Starlink 是免费提供的，但其他系统通常需要预先付款，而且这三个系统都没有提供与 Starlink 相同的速度。

美国航空一般在其国内机队中提供 Viasat WiFi，这对 AAdvantage 会员是免费的，而大多数宽体机都配备了松下系统。达美航空几乎为整个机队提供 Viasat 或 Hughes WiFi。好处是 Viasat 和 Hughes 的速度比 Panasonic 和 Thales 快得多。这些航空公司的缺点是星链提供更快的速度。但对于美联航来说，它现在提供竞争对手中最快和最慢的 WiFi 系统。
美联航希望星链成为相对于竞争对手的主要商业优势，但只有当该系统在美联航的整个机队中使用时，它才会成为真正的优势。更好的 WiFi 系统本身并不一定是客户选择一家航空公司而不是另一家航空公司的原因，但它正在成为购买决策中越来越重要的因素。随着美联航继续以产品和高端品牌为目标，星链对于该航空公司的销售主张变得越来越重要。
星链如何融入美联航的商业战略
通过向高端市场进军并成为“优质”航空公司品牌，美联航希望成为一家能够凭借其名称和产品赢得客户业务的航空公司。这是达美航空2008年与西北航空合并后，在首席执行官理查德·安德森 (Richard Anderson) 的领导下首次实施的战略，如今达美航空已成为美国最成功的航空公司。当然，美国航空公司不是靠卖机票赚钱的，而是靠卖机票赚钱的。相反，这些钱是用于忠诚度计划。

美联航免费提供 Starlink，但只能通过前程万里 (MileagePlus) 帐号访问。注册前程万里 (MileagePlus) 并访问 Starlink 的客户将来可能更倾向于乘坐美联航航班。从那里开始，他们可能更有可能注册前程万里 (MileagePlus) 联名信用卡，这才是真正的钱所在。美联航及其同类公司以极低的成本向信用卡合作伙伴出售大量里程，增加对这些里程的需求符合航空公司的最佳利益。

title_en: Why The World's Largest Commercial Jet Engine Is A Threat To Other Powerplants
title_zh: 为什么世界上最大的商用喷气发动机对其他动力装置构成威胁
summary: The GE9X is the only engine with the thrust a stretched A350 would need, but GE has shown little interest in ending Rolls-Royce’s exclusivity.
summary_zh: GE9X 是唯一一款具有加长型 A350 所需推力的发动机，但 GE 对结束劳斯莱斯的排他性并没有表现出多少兴趣。
body_en: Brandon's passion for aviation started at a young age. He became involved in the flight simulator and VATSIM communities, which sparked his interest in aviation and eventually led him to earn his private pilot license. Outside of work, he continues to build flight hours, explore new airports, and stay involved in the aviation community.

GE Aerospace describes the GE9X as the largest and most powerful commercial aircraft engine ever built, and the specifications support the claim. A 134-inch front fan, a composite fan case, ceramic matrix composites in the hot section, and a 60:1 overall pressure ratio make it the most advanced large turbofan in production, and Guinness World Records certifies it as the most powerful commercial jet engine by test performance. None of that puts competitive pressure on anyone, because the engine has no rival to fight. GE holds the 777X exclusively, as it has held every 777 variant since the 777-200LR .

Where the engine matters commercially is on an aircraft it has never powered. Rolls-Royce has supplied the only engine ever offered on the Airbus A350 , a position no competitor has challenged in two decades, and Airbus is now studying a stretched version of that aircraft aimed at the roughly 400-seat market the 777-9 currently has to itself. A stretch of that size needs more thrust than the Trent XWB-97 produces, and the GE9X sits in exactly that class. Airbus has looked at the idea. By most accounts, GE has not shown much appetite for it.
The Largest Engine Ever Built, By The Numbers That Hold Up

The headline dimension is the front fan, which measures 134 inches across and carries 16 fourth-generation carbon fiber composite blades inside a composite fan case. GE’s product material claims that this makes the fan larger than a Boeing 737 fuselage. Key.Aero frames the comparison more precisely, describing the engine’s overall diameter, rather than the fan alone, as greater than the fuselage diameter of the 737 family. Either way, the GE9X is the largest installation ever hung under a commercial wing.

Thrust needs the same care. Guinness World Records lists the GE9X at a maximum thrust of 134,300 pounds , achieved during an engineering test at GE’s outdoor facility in Peebles, Ohio, on November 10, 2017, breaking the 127,900 pounds the GE90-115B recorded in 2002. Guinness also lists the engine’s rated thrust as 110,000 pounds and notes that the record reflects testing conditions rather than commercial operation. For service on the 777-9, the engine is certified to 105,000 pounds. The record figure therefore describes what the architecture can produce at its limits, not what a flight crew will ever command.

Efficiency is where the design earns its reputation. GE puts the GE9X at approximately a 10:1 bypass ratio and a 60:1 overall pressure ratio, with specific fuel consumption up to 10% better than the GE90-115B. Ceramic matrix composites appear in the combustor liner and the high-pressure turbine shrouds, parts that tolerate higher temperatures with less cooling air than the metal components they replace. GE says the engine received FAA certification in September 2020, after 27,000 cycles and 17,000 hours of testing.
Why Rolls-Royce Has Owned The A350 Since 2006

Every A350 ever built flies behind the same engine. Rolls-Royce supplies the Trent XWB as the family’s sole powerplant across a thrust range. Simple Flying puts it at 84,000 to 97,000 pounds, and no alternative has ever been offered to a customer. For a widebody that has sold in A350 numbers, that is unusual, and it exists because of a decision GE made rather than a competition Rolls-Royce won.

Aero-News Network reported in 2008 that GE executives had told Airbus the company would not build an engine to compete with the GE90 it supplies for the 777, leaving Airbus with a Trent variant as its only option for the A350. Airbus sales chief John Leahy had already closed the other door, saying, “We have no intention of putting their GEnx engine on the A350 at all.” GE’s view was that the GEnx suited the smaller A350 variants but could not economically scale to the thrust the A350-1000 required.

Commercially, the refusal was straightforward. GE is the exclusive engine supplier for the 777-200LR, the 777-300ER and the 777 freighter , and the A350-1000 was designed to take sales from precisely those aircraft. Developing a 97,000-pound engine for Airbus would have handed airlines a GE-powered alternative to a GE-powered Boeing, buying a share of one program at the cost of a monopoly on another. Rolls-Royce, which had lost the 777 engine competition to the GE90, took the work instead and has held the position ever since.
The Stretch That Would Reopen The Engine Question
Credit: Nattanon Tavonthammarit | Shutterstock

Airbus has been circling a larger A350 for most of 2026. Commercial aircraft CEO Lars Wagner told the media in Toulouse that a decision on stretching both the A350 and the A220 would come before 2030 , adding that there is “clearly” demand from the industry for longer versions of each. Aerospace Global News reported that Wagner tied both projects to viable business cases and board approval, while acknowledging that customers are waiting for each aircraft.

Thrust is the obstacle that makes the engine question unavoidable. AIN reported that a stretch would need more thrust than the A350-1000’s Trent XWB-97 can provide , and that the alternatives are limited. By AIN’s reckoning, one option would be the GE9X that powers the 777-9, an engine already certified in the class a 400-seat Airbus would require. Rolls-Royce has signaled nothing publicly about an XWB above 97,000 pounds, leaving the stretch dependent either on an unannounced derivative or on a supplier Airbus has never used on the program.

Wagner’s own answer was carefully incomplete. Pressed by reporters on whether Rolls-Royce would automatically keep its exclusive position on a prospective A350-2000, he declined to confirm it , and he declined to specify whether Airbus is engaged with GE Aerospace on supplying engines for the aircraft. He did say Airbus is happy with Rolls-Royce and that the exclusive partnership “works well” for the A350 family. Those two positions aren't contradictory, but together they fall short of the commitment Rolls-Royce has enjoyed since the program began.

The obstacle to the GE9X on an A350 is not Rolls-Royce. Reuters reported in October that industry sources say Airbus has toyed with using a GE Aerospace engine for the roughly 400-seat A350-2000, but that the engine maker has so far shown limited interest in joining. Airbus, in other words, has considered the option and GE has not pursued it.
body_zh: 布兰登从小就对航空充满热情。他参与了飞行模拟器和 VATSIM 社区，这激发了他对航空的兴趣，并最终使他获得了私人飞行员执照。工作之余，他继续增加飞行时间、探索新机场并继续参与航空界。

GE 航空航天公司将 GE9X 描述为有史以来最大、最强大的商用飞机发动机，其规格也支持了这一说法。 134英寸前风扇、复合材料风扇罩、热部陶瓷基复合材料以及60:1的总压比使其成为目前量产中最先进的大型涡扇发动机，并被吉尼斯世界纪录认证为测试性能最强的商用喷气发动机。这些都不会给任何人带来竞争压力，因为引擎没有竞争对手。 GE 独家拥有 777X，因为它拥有自 777-200LR 以来的所有 777 型号。

发动机在商业上的重要意义是在从未为其提供动力的飞机上。罗尔斯·罗伊斯公司为空客 A350 提供了有史以来唯一的发动机，二十年来没有竞争对手挑战过这一地位，空客现在正在研究该飞机的加长版本，瞄准 777-9 目前拥有的约 400 座的市场。这种尺寸的延伸需要比遄达 XWB-97 产生的推力更大，而 GE9X 正是属于这个级别。空中客车公司已经考虑过这个想法。大多数人认为，通用电气对此并没有表现出太大的兴趣。
有史以来最大的发动机，数据可靠
主要尺寸是前风扇，其直径为 134 英寸，复合材料风扇箱内装有 16 个第四代碳纤维复合材料叶片。 GE 的产品材料声称，这使得风扇比波音 737 机身还要大。 Key.Aero 更准确地进行了比较，将发动机的整体直径（而不是单独的风扇）描述为大于 737 系列的机身直径。无论哪种方式，GE9X 都是有史以来悬挂在商业翼下的最大安装。

推力需要同样的照顾。吉尼斯世界纪录将 GE9X 的最大推力列为 134,300 磅，这是 2017 年 11 月 10 日在俄亥俄州皮布尔斯的 GE 户外设施进行的工程测试中实现的，打破了 GE90-115B 在 2002 年记录的 127,900 磅。吉尼斯世界纪录还列出了该发动机的额定推力为 110,000 磅，并指出该记录反映的是测试条件而不是商业记录。操作。对于 777-9 上的维修，该发动机经认证可承受 105,000 磅的重量。因此，这个创纪录的数字描述的是该架构在其极限下可以产生什么，而不是机组人员将指挥什么。
效率是设计赢得声誉的关键。 GE 将 GE9X 的涵道比和总压比约为 10:1，总压力比为 60:1，燃油消耗率比 GE90-115B 低 10%。陶瓷基复合材料出现在燃烧室衬里和高压涡轮护罩中，这些部件比它们所取代的金属部件能够承受更高的温度，且冷却空气更少。 GE 表示，经过 27,000 次循环和 17,000 小时的测试，该发动机于 2020 年 9 月获得了 FAA 认证。
为什么劳斯莱斯自 2006 年起就拥有 A350
每架 A350 都使用相同的发动机。劳斯莱斯提供遄达 XWB 作为该系列推力范围内唯一的动力装置。 Simple Flying 称其重量为 84,000 至 97,000 磅，并且从未向客户提供替代方案。对于已售出 A350 数量的宽体飞机来说，这是不寻常的，它的存在是因为 GE 做出的决定，而不是劳斯莱斯赢得的竞争。

航空新闻网 2008 年报道称，GE 高管告诉空中客车公司，该公司不会制造与其为 777 供应的 GE90 发动机竞争的发动机，因此空中客车公司将遄达型发动机作为 A350 的唯一选择。空客销售主管约翰·莱希(John Leahy)已经关上了另一扇门，他说：“我们根本无意将他们的GEnx发动机安装在A350上。” GE 的观点是，GEnx 适合较小的 A350 型号，但无法经济地扩展至 A350-1000 所需的推力。

从商业角度来看，拒绝是直截了当的。 GE 是 777-200LR、777-300ER 和 777 货机的独家发动机供应商，而 A350-1000 正是为了抢占这些飞机的销量而设计的。为空中客车公司开发一款 97,000 磅重的发动机，将为航空公司提供一个由 GE 提供动力的替代方案，以取代由 GE 提供动力的波音公司，以垄断另一个项目的代价购买一个项目的份额。罗尔斯·罗伊斯公司在 777 发动机的竞争中输给了 GE90，取而代之，并从此占据了这一位置。
会重新打开引擎问题的伸展
图片来源：Nattanon Tavonthammarit | Shutterstock
空中客车公司在 2026 年的大部分时间里一直在考虑推出更大的 A350。商用飞机首席执行官拉尔斯·瓦格纳 (Lars Wagner) 在图卢兹向媒体表示，加长 A350 和 A220 的决定将在 2030 年之前做出，并补充说，业界“显然”对加长版本的 A350 存在需求。 《航空航天全球新闻》报道称，瓦格纳将这两个项目都与可行的商业案例和董事会批准联系起来，同时承认客户正在等待每架飞机。

推力是发动机问题不可避免的障碍。 AIN 报道称，拉伸需要比 A350-1000 的遄达 XWB-97 提供的推力更大的推力，而且替代方案有限。根据 AIN 的计算，一个选择是为 777-9 提供动力的 GE9X，该发动机已通过 400 座空客所需级别的认证。罗尔斯·罗伊斯公司尚未公开表示有关 97,000 磅以上 XWB 的任何信息，因此该扩展要么依赖于未宣布的衍生品，要么依赖于空客从未在该计划中使用过的供应商。
瓦格纳自己的回答显然是不完整的。当记者追问劳斯莱斯是否会自动保留其在未来 A350-2000 上的独家地位时，他拒绝证实，也拒绝具体说明空中客车公司是否与通用电气航空航天公司合作为该飞机提供发动机。他确实表示空客对劳斯莱斯感到满意，并且这种独家合作伙伴关系对于 A350 系列来说“效果很好”。这两个立场并不矛盾，但它们加起来并没有达到劳斯莱斯自该计划开始以来所享有的承诺。
A350 上的 GE9X 的障碍不是劳斯莱斯。路透社 10 月份报道称，业内消息人士称，空客曾考虑在大约 400 座的 A350-2000 上使用 GE 航空航天发动机，但该发动机制造商迄今为止表现出的加入兴趣有限。换句话说，空中客车公司已经考虑过这种选择，而通用电气尚未采取这种选择。

title_en: How Much Does It Cost To Earn United Premier 1K Status In 2026?
title_zh: 2026 年获得美联航 Premier 1K 会员身份需要花多少钱？
summary: The program's most recent change took place earlier this year, fine-tuning the mile-earning schedule for today's economy.
summary_zh: 该计划的最新变化发生在今年早些时候，针对当今的经济状况微调了里程赚取时间表。
body_en: Ethan is an aviation professional with a degree in Aviation Management with Flight from the Florida Institute of Technology. He previously wrote aviation and tourism features for Florida Tech’s student newspaper, The Crimson , where he developed a clear, reader‑focused reporting style. Aviation journalism has remained a consistent priority throughout his career.

He currently holds a Restricted ATP and Commercial Multi‑Engine Pilot certificate and works in aviation supply chain and aircraft component repair. Alongside his industry role, he is pursuing his Certified Flight Instructor rating and actively building flight experience.
A lifelong aviation enthusiast, Ethan spent countless hours at Raleigh–Durham International Airport’s observation deck studying air traffic and practicing amateur photography and videography.

United Airlines ' MileagePlus program launched on May 6, 1981, according to The Points Guy . The program, which celebrated its 45th anniversary this year, has undergone many iterations, particularly after the 2010 merger with Continental Airlines . According to NerdWallet , the program's most recent change took place on April 2, fine-tuning the mile-earning schedule for today's economy. Basic Economy officially no longer earns travelers miles, and it has reduced miles per dollar earned at each status level.

Premier 1K, United's top tier of earned status for passengers, grants a variety of benefits, amenities, and privileges onboard and in the airport. Premier 1K unlocks United's most comprehensive set of publicly available elite benefits, including priority pre-boarding, complimentary Premier Upgrades cleared as early as 96 hours before departure, three free checked bags, Economy Plus seating at booking for the member and up to eight companions, access to expanded award availability, a dedicated Premier phone line, and a bonus of 280 PlusPoints that can be used to request upgrades on eligible flights.

There are two main ways to achieve such status, including flying on United or United Express operated flights in a class other than Basic Economy, and with credit card spending with United's co-branded Chase credit card lineup. The exclusivity comes at a price, and not just anyone may qualify for Premier 1K, let alone United's entry level status, Premier Silver. For the 2026 qualification year, United Airlines illustrates on its website that earning Premier 1K status requires either 28,000 Premier Qualifying Points (PQP) or a combination of 22,000 PQP and 60 Premier Qualifying Flights (PQF).

PQPs are generally earned based on how much a traveler spends on United-operated flights, preferred seating, upgrades, and select partner airline tickets. The requirement makes Premier 1K one of the most expensive top-tier status levels among major US airlines.

A PQP measures the money you spend on airfare and eligible credit card purchases (typically earning 1 PQP per dollar spent on base fares). A PQF counts each individual flight segment you take on United, United Express, or eligible partner airlines. PQFs include layover segments. For instance, a round trip flight with a layover in each direction equals four PQFs earned.

The qualification requirements have steadily increased throughout the loyalty program's history. Following the merger with Continental Airlines and a broader airline industry trend toward revenue-based loyalty programs, United has increasingly prioritized spending over simply logging miles flown. Today, how much a passenger spends matters significantly more than how far they travel.
The Minimum Card Spend Required For Premier 1K

According to NerdWallet , one cannot simply earn Premier 1K status simply through spending on one of United's Chase cards. While a strong supplement in the pursuit of Premier 1K, it is not enough alone to suffice. United requires a four PQF minimum in order to qualify for any premier status, including the entry level Premier Silver.

While Premier 1K may traditionally be associated with road warriors flying hundreds of thousands of miles annually, United's current rules allow members to earn the vast majority of the required 28,000 PQP through credit card spending. The absolute maximum utilizing credit card spend requires 28,000 PQP, plus the four-flight minimum. Depending on the specific Chase card in use, one can earn 1 PQP per $20 spent or 1 PQP per $15 spent, translating to $560,000 or $420,000 in credit card spend annually.

In practical terms, a traveler pursuing status exclusively through credit card spending must supplement their spending with four PQF segments on United or an authorized partner airline. Business travelers whose employers pay for frequent premium cabin trips often reach the threshold naturally, whereas leisure travelers typically require a more deliberate strategy involving credit card spending and frequent travel.
Premier 1K, According To The President Of MileagePlus

United's leadership has repeatedly emphasized that Premier 1K is intended to reward the airline's most loyal and highest-value customers. While MileagePlus has evolved significantly since its 1981 launch, the core philosophy remains centered around recognizing travelers who consistently choose United throughout the year. That philosophy is reflected in the program's modern qualification structure, where spending and engagement with the airline carry greater weight than mileage alone.

Jarad Fisher, President of United MileagePlus, joined United in February, having a proven track record as the Chief of Delta Air Lines ' SkyMiles program, as well as being the creator of the Apple Card. The Points Guy has reported that Fisher describes Premier 1K earning in 2026 as majority PQP based, with United credit cards bridging the gap .

United continues moving toward revenue-based loyalty metrics. In October 2026, the carrier announced that Premier Qualifying Flights (PQF) would be removed from status qualification beginning in 2027, leaving Premier Qualifying Points (PQP) as the primary path to elite status. The change reinforces United's view that Premier status, particularly Premier 1K, should primarily reward customer value and spending rather than simply the number of flights taken.
PlusPoints, Million Miler, and Status Match Implications

Reaching Premier 1K is not solely about upgrades and priority boarding. United's broader loyalty ecosystem includes benefits such as PlusPoints, Million Miler status, and occasional status match opportunities from other airlines, all of which can influence whether pursuing 1K is worthwhile. For some travelers, these supplemental benefits may ultimately provide more value than the status title itself.
body_zh: Ethan 是一名航空专业人士，拥有佛罗里达理工学院飞行管理学位。他此前曾为佛罗里达理工学院的学生报纸《The Crimson》撰写航空和旅游专题文章，在那里他开发了一种清晰、以读者为中心的报道风格。在他的整个职业生涯中，航空新闻始终是优先考虑的事情。
他目前持有受限 ATP 和商业多引擎飞行员证书，从事航空供应链和飞机部件维修工作。除了他的行业角色外，他还追求认证飞行教练评级并积极积累飞行经验。
伊森是一位终生的航空爱好者，他在罗利-达勒姆国际机场的观景台上花费了无数时间研究空中交通并练习业余摄影和摄像。

据 The Points Guy 报道，联合航空的前程万里 (MileagePlus) 计划于 1981 年 5 月 6 日启动。该计划今年庆祝了 45 周年，经历了多次迭代，特别是在 2010 年与大陆航空合并之后。据 NerdWallet 称，该计划的最新变化发生在 4 月 2 日，针对当今的经济状况微调了里程赚取时间表。基础经济舱正式不再赚取旅行者里程，并且减少了每个身份级别每美元赚取的里程数。
Premier 1K 是美联航为乘客赢得的最高等级身份，可在机上和机场内享受各种福利、便利设施和特权。 Premier 1K 解锁美联航最全面的公开精英福利，包括优先登机、最早在出发前 96 小时办理免费贵宾升舱、三件免费托运行李、预订时为会员和最多 8 名同伴提供豪华经济舱座位、扩大奖励范围、专用贵宾电话线以及可用于在符合条件的航班上申请升舱的 280 点 PlusPoints 奖励。

获得此资格的主要方式有两种，包括乘坐美联航或联航快运运营的除基础经济舱以外的航班，以及使用美联航联名大通信用卡系列进行信用卡消费。这种排他性是有代价的，并不是任何人都有资格获得 Premier 1K，更不用说曼联的入门级身份——Premier Silver 了。对于 2026 年资格年，联合航空在其网站上说明，获得贵宾 1K 身份需要 28,000 点贵宾资格积分 (PQP) 或 22,000 点 PQP 和 60 次贵宾资格航班 (PQF) 的组合。
PQP 的赚取通常取决于旅客在美联航运营的航班、首选座位、升舱和精选合作伙伴机票上的花费。这一要求使得 Premier 1K 成为美国主要航空公司中最昂贵的顶级身份级别之一。
PQP 衡量您在机票和符合条件的信用卡购买上花费的金额（通常每花费 1 美元基本票价即可赚取 1 PQP）。 PQF 计算您乘坐美联航、联航快运或符合条件的合作伙伴航空公司的每个单独的航段。 PQF 包括中转段。例如，往返航班在每个方向中途停留相当于获得 4 个 PQF。
在忠诚度计划的整个历史中，资格要求一直在稳步提高。与大陆航空合并后，加上航空业更广泛地转向以收入为基础的忠诚度计划，美联航越来越重视支出，而不是简单地记录飞行里程。如今，乘客花多少钱比他们旅行多远更重要。
Premier 1K 所需的最低卡消费额
根据 NerdWallet 的说法，人们不能仅通过在一张曼联大通卡上消费来获得 Premier 1K 身份。虽然是追求 Premier 1K 的有力补充，但仅靠它还不够。美联航至少需要四个 PQF 才能获得任何高级会员资格，包括入门级高级银卡会员。

虽然 Premier 1K 传统上可能与每年飞行数十万英里的公路战士联系在一起，但美联航目前的规则允许会员通过信用卡消费赚取所需 28,000 PQP 的绝大多数。使用信用卡的绝对最高消费额需要 28,000 PQP，加上四趟航班的最低消费额。根据所使用的具体 Chase 卡，每消费 20 美元可赚取 1 PQP，或每消费 1​​5 美元可赚取 1 PQP，相当于每年信用卡消费 560,000 美元或 420,000 美元。
实际上，仅通过信用卡消费追求身份的旅客必须在美联航或授权合作伙伴航空公司的四个 PQF 航段中补充其消费。雇主支付频繁的高级客舱旅行费用的商务旅行者通常会自然地达到门槛，而休闲旅行者通常需要更审慎的策略，包括信用卡消费和频繁旅行。
据前程万里 (MileagePlus) 总裁介绍，Premier 1K
美联航领导层多次强调 Premier 1K 旨在奖励该航空公司最忠诚和最高价值的客户。尽管前程万里 (MileagePlus) 自 1981 年推出以来已取得显着发展，但其核心理念仍然是认可全年始终选择美联航的旅客。这一理念体现在该计划的现代资格结构中，在该结构中，支出和与航空公司的互动比单独的里程更重要。
联合航空前程万里 (MileagePlus) 总裁贾拉德·费舍尔 (Jarad Fisher) 于 2 月加入联合航空，作为达美航空“飞凡里程常客计划”的负责人有着良好的业绩记录，同时也是 Apple Card 的创始人。 The Points Guy 报道称，费舍尔将 2026 年的 Premier 1K 收入描述为大部分基于 PQP，而美联航信用卡弥补了这一差距。
美联航继续转向基于收入的忠诚度指标。 2026 年 10 月，该航空公司宣布将从 2027 年开始取消贵宾资格航班 (PQF) 的身份资格，将贵宾资格积分 (PQP) 作为获得精英身份的主要途径。这一变化强化了美联航的观点，即贵宾 (Premier) 身份，尤其是 Premier 1K，应该主要奖励客户价值和支出，而不仅仅是乘坐的航班数量。
PlusPoints、百万英里会员和状态匹配影响
达到 Premier 1K 不仅仅意味着升舱和优先登机。美联航更广泛的忠诚度生态系统包括 PlusPoints、百万英里会员 (Million Miler) 会员资格以及其他航空公司偶尔提供的会员资格匹配机会等福利，所有这些都会影响追求 1K 是否值得。对于一些旅行者来说，这些补充福利最终可能比身份头衔本身提供更多的价值。

title_en: Finnair Celebrates International Men’s Day With All-Male Crew On Flight
title_zh: 芬兰航空机上全是男性机组人员庆祝国际男性节
summary: Finnair marked International Men's Day by operating a Helsinki to London flight with an all-male crew, aiming to highlight that only around 10% of its cabin crew are men.
summary_zh: 芬兰航空为庆祝国际男性日，运营了一架由全男性机组人员组成的赫尔辛基飞往伦敦的航班，旨在强调只有约 10% 的男性机组人员
body_en: There’s still quite a gender gap in the airline industry, with a disproportionate number of pilots being male, and a disproportionate number of flight attendants being female. Airlines will sometimes have special celebrations with all-female crews, so here’s an interesting twist on that.

Today is (apparently) International Men’s Day. We often see airlines commemorate International Women’s Day, but there aren’t many airlines that celebrate the equivalent for men… well, except Finnair! The airline has today operated its annual flight with an all-male crew. This was the case for Finnair flight AY1331, from Helsinki (HEL) to London (LHR), using an Airbus A350-900.

The crew consisted of 10 people, comprised of two pilots and eight flight attendants. The gate agents were also all men. So, why is this important? Finnair highlights how only around 10% of cabin crew at the airline are male, but the company hopes to see that number grow in the future.
I think this is a fun concept, and it would be nice to see a closer to 50/50 gender ratio in both the cockpit and cabin, as it would show that everyone is given a fair chance at such a career.

I think it’s worth acknowledging that at many airlines, hiring of flight attendants is still primarily or exclusively based on gender. Now, the policies do vary significantly by airline, but perhaps an extreme example is India’s largest airline, IndiGo, which only hires female flight attendants. It’s literally written on the application , that it’s a job for “Female Indian nationals.”

It’s all so strange, because the airline has this super enthusiastic page about the importance of diversity in the workplace, and says “all employment decisions are made solely on the basis of merit and qualifications, without regard to a candidate’s gender…” You mean except the single largest portion of your workforce, which is cabin crew?

What’s interesting is that while those gender restrictions exist in the cabin, roughly 18% of the carrier’s pilots are female, which is way above the global average of 7%. That’s obviously a conscious effort, so I guess the idea is that women can become pilots but men can’t become flight attendants.

In fairness, I suspect part of the motivation here is that IndiGo flight attendants share hotel rooms on layovers, and that is a bit more complicated with mixed genders. Then again, it seems easy enough to just try to pair male flight attendants on trips, so it’s hardly a hurdle that can’t be overcome.

While we’re used to seeing airlines celebrate International Women’s Day, it’s rare to see an airline celebrating International Men’s Day. Finnair has operated an all-male flight today, intended to highlight how only 10% of flight attendants at the airline are male, and the airline wants to change that. While an unconventional initiative nowadays, I think this is still pretty cool.
What do you make of Finnair’s all-male flight?
body_zh: 航空业仍然存在相当大的性别差距，男性飞行员比例过高，而女性空乘人员比例过高。航空公司有时会与全女性机组人员一起举办特别的庆祝活动，所以这里有一个有趣的变化。
今天（显然）是国际男人节。我们经常看到航空公司庆祝国际妇女节，但没有多少航空公司为男性庆祝这一节日……好吧，除了芬兰航空！该航空公司今天运营了年度航班，机组人员全部为男性。芬兰航空 AY1331 航班就是这种情况，该航班从赫尔辛基 (HEL) 飞往伦敦 (LHR)，使用的是空客 A350-900。
机组人员共有10人，其中包括两名飞行员和八名空乘人员。登机口的工作人员也都是男性。那么，为什么这很重要？芬兰航空强调，该公司只有约 10% 的机组人员是男性，但该公司希望看到这一数字在未来继续增长。
我认为这是一个有趣的概念，如果驾驶舱和客舱的性别比例接近 50/50，那就太好了，因为这表明每个人都有公平的机会从事这样的职业。
我认为值得承认的是，在许多航空公司，招聘空乘人员仍然主要或完全基于性别。现在，不同航空公司的政策确实存在很大差异，但也许一个极端的例子是印度最大的航空公司靛蓝航空，该公司只雇用女性空乘人员。申请表上字面意思是，这是一份针对“印度女性国民”的工作。
这一切都很奇怪，因为该航空公司有一个超级热情的页面，宣传工作场所多元化的重要性，并表示“所有就业决定都完全根据优点和资格做出，而不考虑候选人的性别……”你的意思是除了你的劳动力中最大的一部分，即机组人员？
有趣的是，虽然机舱内存在性别限制，但该航空公司飞行员中大约有 18% 是女性，远高于 7% 的全球平均水平。这显然是有意识的努力，所以我想这个想法是女性可以成为飞行员，但男性不能成为空乘人员。
公平地说，我怀疑这里的部分动机是靛蓝航空的空乘人员在中途停留时共用酒店房间，而对于混合性别来说，情况会稍微复杂一些。话又说回来，在旅行中尝试为男性空乘配对似乎很容易，所以这并不是一个无法克服的障碍。
虽然我们习惯于看到航空公司庆祝国际妇女节，但很少看到航空公司庆祝国际男人节。芬兰航空今天运营了一个全男性航班，旨在强调该航空公司只有 10% 的空乘人员是男性，该航空公司希望改变这一现状。虽然现在这是一个非常规的举措，但我认为这仍然很酷。
您如何看待芬兰航空的全男性航班？

title_en: What Air Force One Pilots Do Before Flights That Most Other Pilots Never Do
title_zh: 空军一号飞行员在飞行前所做的事情是大多数其他飞行员从不做的
summary: How the US president travels by air.
summary_zh: 美国总统如何乘飞机旅行。
body_en: Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

Standard actions for a commercial airline crew before a flight include reviewing the flight with each other, followed by a pre-flight walkaround. Later, the crew sets up the flight deck, inputs their flight plan into the aircraft's computer, and verifies the aircraft's weight and balance figures before pushback. It's a thorough procedure to ensure the aircraft is fully ready to operate safely, and these procedures apply to essentially every commercial flight.

The pilots of Air Force One also do these actions, but their pre-flight duties are much more thorough because of their job: transporting the President of the United States. Air Force One is a callsign used to denote any US Air Force (USAF) aircraft flying the President, but it is most commonly associated with two Boeing VC-25As and the VC-25B Bridge, which are based on the Boeing 747 . Crucially, the flight crew is concerned not just with safety, but also with security.

The two VC-25As are typically flown by two pilots, a flight engineer, and a navigator, while the VC-25B Bridge does not require a flight engineer (because it's based on the newer 747-8). Before each flight, they coordinate with ground crews to verify that the apron and runway are clear of potential debris. The flight plan itself may look significantly different from what airliners operate, and the crew also needs to ensure that the aircraft's onboard security and defense systems are operational.

In addition to these actions, the flight crew of Air Force One needs to help maintain security. This means not just coordinating with security teams on the apron, but also with air traffic control to ensure that the airport and surrounding airspace is clear of any potential conflicts. The crew also verifies that the aircraft will receive priority handling from air traffic control, and they also must review aerial refueling procedures for the VC-25A, although this capability has never been used with the president onboard.

The pilots typically must arrive three to four hours before the scheduled flight, coordinating with the US Secret Service to maintain security on the aircraft and at the airport. The aircraft is inspected, and its systems are tested to check for any potential technical faults. In addition, the crew has to review emergency procedures while also performing the more typical actions that you'd expect during the pre-flight flow. While this is usually a multi-hour process, flight crews are trained to perform departures with as little as an hour's notice.

Every long-distance trip undertaken by the US president begins and ends at the White House South Lawn. Here, the president boards a US Marine Corps helicopter operating under the callsign 'Marine One', the callsign used for any USMC aircraft carrying the US president. The helicopter, which may be joined by several others during the trip, flies to Andrews Air Force Base, home to the Presidential Airlift Group. The flight typically takes about six to ten minutes, and when the president lands, Air Force One is already waiting.

The VC-25s not only carry the president, but they also transport the president's Secret Service detail, senior staff, medical personnel, and advisors. In addition, the aircraft will typically carry the White House press pool, a rotating group of reporters and journalists covering the president. The president is always the last person to board the aircraft, and once he/she is onboard, the doors close before the engines are started. From there, the aircraft taxis to the runway and takes off.

Upon arrival, the airport receiving Air Force One typically suspends operations . From there, the president may either take a motorcade or another US Marine Corps helicopter to their final destination. The vehicles required for the motorcade and the USMC helicopters are typically flown in ahead of time via a Lockheed C-5 Galaxy to ensure that they're ready for the president's arrival. When it's time to return to Washington, this process repeats itself.

The pilots commanding the VC-25s must be experienced airmen serving with the US Air Force. Generally, these crew members have prior experience operating complex multi-engine transport aircraft and must have logged a significant number of flight hours (generally at least 2,500 hours). From there, pilots usually transfer to the 89th Airlift Wing at Andrews Air Force Base and build experience transporting other executives on aircraft like the Boeing C-32 or C-40 Clipper.

Pilots must maintain an exemplary flying record while serving in the USAF and keep a spotless permanent record. In addition, they must earn high-level qualifications to stand out further. Senior leadership evaluates the pilot roster at the 89th Airlift Wing, then handpicks the top aviators to enter the selection process for the Presidential Airlift Group. From there, the selection process includes interviews, psychological screenings, and simulator tests.

The final piece for those selected to pilot the VC-25 is to obtain ' Yankee White ' clearance. This is a special, top-level security clearance reserved for personnel supporting the US president and vice president, and getting it requires an extremely thorough background check. Investigators may interview family members and peers, as well as former neighbors or teachers to verify stability, loyalty, and dependability, in a process that can take as long as a year. Candidates must also have a spotless criminal and financial history.
The Other Means Of Air Transport For The US President

The VC-25As that commonly serve as Air Force One are designed to serve as invulnerable command centers in the sky. They feature advanced defense and communications systems, while also being equipped with aerial refueling systems so that they may remain airborne until food and water run out. However, the 747-based VC-25As are also massive aircraft. Not every airport can easily accommodate the VC-25As, and they draw a huge amount of attention, which isn't always ideal.

While the VC-25As are the most common aircraft that serve as Air Force One, the US president also occasionally travels on the Boeing C-32A, based on the 757-200. These planes are generally used when the president is traveling to airfields that cannot accommodate the VC-25A, and they can also be used as a backup aircraft when the president travels, as well as if a VC-25A is unavailable. Furthermore, the C-32s are useful when the president is traveling on sensitive missions, such as to active war zones.
body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
商业航空公司机组人员在飞行前的标准行动包括相互检查飞行情况，然后进行飞行前巡视。随后，机组人员设置驾驶舱，将飞行计划输入飞机的计算机，并在推回前验证飞机的重量和平衡数据。这是确保飞机完全准备好安全运行的彻底程序，这些程序基本上适用于每次商业航班。
空军一号的飞行员也会做这些动作，但由于他们的工作：运送美国总统，他们的飞行前职责要彻底得多。空军一号是一个呼号，用于表示总统乘坐的任何美国空军 (USAF) 飞机，但它最常与两架波音 VC-25A 和 VC-25B 舰桥联系在一起，它们基于波音 747 设计。至关重要的是，机组人员不仅关心安全，还关心安保。
两架 VC-25A 通常由两名飞行员、一名飞行工程师和一名导航员驾驶，而 VC-25B 桥则不需要飞行工程师（因为它基于较新的 747-8）。每次飞行前，他们都会与地勤人员协调，确认停机坪和跑道上没有潜在的碎片。飞行计划本身可能与客机的运行计划有很大不同，机组人员还需要确保飞机的机载安全和防御系统正常运行。
除了这些行动之外，空军一号的机组人员还需要帮助维护安全。这意味着不仅要与停机坪上的安全团队进行协调，还要与空中交通管制进行协调，以确保机场和周围空域没有任何潜在的冲突。机组人员还验证飞机是否会得到空中交通管制的优先处理，他们还必须审查 VC-25A 的空中加油程序，尽管这一功能从未在总统机上使用过。
飞行员通常必须在预定航班起飞前三到四个小时到达，与美国特勤局协调以维持飞机和机场的安全。检查飞机并测试其系统，以检查是否存在任何潜在的技术故障。此外，机组人员必须审查应急程序，同时还要执行您在飞行前流程中期望的更典型的操作。虽然这通常是一个数小时的过程，但机组人员经过培训，可以在短短一小时内通知就执行起飞。
美国总统每次长途旅行的起点和终点都是白宫南草坪。图中，总统登上了一架美国海军陆战队直升机，其呼号为“海军陆战一号”，该呼号用于任何载有美国总统的美国海军陆战队飞机。这架直升机在旅途中可能会与其他几架直升机一起飞往总统空运大队的所在地安德鲁斯空军基地。飞行通常需要大约六到十分钟，当总统降落时，空军一号已经在等待。
VC-25 不仅运载总统，还运载总统的特勤人员、高级职员、医务人员和顾问。此外，这架飞机通常会搭载白宫记者团，这是一组轮流报道总统的记者和记者。总统总是最后一个登上飞机的人，一旦他/她登机，舱门就会在发动机启动之前关闭。从那里，飞机滑行到跑道并起飞。
空军一号抵达后，接收机场通常会暂停运营。从那里，总统可以乘坐车队或另一架美国海军陆战队直升机前往最终目的地。车队和美国海军陆战队直升机所需的车辆通常通过洛克希德 C-5 Galaxy 提前空运，以确保它们为总统的到来做好准备。当返回华盛顿时，这个过程会重复进行。
指挥 VC-25 的飞行员必须是在美国空军服役的经验丰富的飞行员。一般来说，这些机组人员之前有操作复杂的多引擎运输机的经验，并且必须记录大量的飞行小时（通常至少 2,500 小时）。飞行员通常会从那里转移到安德鲁斯空军基地的第 89 空运联队，积累使用波音 C-32 或 C-40 Clipper 等飞机运送其他高管的经验。
飞行员在美国空军服役期间必须保持模范飞行记录，并保持一尘不染的永久记录。此外，他们必须获得高水平的资格才能进一步脱颖而出。高级领导层评估第 89 空运联队的飞行员名册，然后精心挑选顶尖飞行员进入总统空运大队的选拔过程。从那里开始，选拔过程包括面试、心理筛查和模拟器测试。
对于那些被选中驾驶 VC-25 的人来说，最后一步是获得“Yankee White”许可。这是为支持美国总统和副总统的人员保留的特殊顶级安全许可，获得它需要极其彻底的背景调查。调查人员可能会采访家庭成员和同伴，以及以前的邻居或老师，以验证稳定性、忠诚度和可靠性，这一过程可能需要长达一年的时间。候选人还必须拥有无犯罪记录和财务记录。
美国总统的其他航空运输方式
通常充当空军一号的 VC-25A 旨在充当空中坚不可摧的指挥中心。它们具有先进的防御和通信系统，同时还配备了空中加油系统，以便它们可以保持在空中，直到食物和水耗尽。然而，基于 747 的 VC-25A 也是大型飞机。并非每个机场都能轻松容纳 VC-25A，而且它们吸引了大量注意力，但这并不总是理想的。
虽然 VC-25A 是最常见的空军一号飞机，但美国总统偶尔也会乘坐基于 757-200 改进的波音 C-32A。这些飞机通常在总统前往无法容纳 VC-25A 的机场时使用，也可以在总统旅行时以及在没有 VC-25A 的情况下用作备用飞机。此外，当总统执行敏感任务（例如前往活跃的战区）时，C-32 非常有用。

title_en: JetBlue Doubles Down In Fort Lauderdale With New Flights To Grand Cayman & Honduras In 2027
title_zh: 捷蓝航空于 2027 年在劳德代尔堡增设飞往大开曼岛和洪都拉斯的新航班
summary: JetBlue expands its Fort Lauderdale international network as passenger growth outpaces capacity increases following Spirit Airlines' collapse.
summary_zh: 精神航空倒闭后，乘客增长超过了运力增长，捷蓝航空扩大了劳德代尔堡国际网络。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

JetBlue Airways announced two new daily international services from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) on Thursday, connecting South Florida with Grand Cayman and Tegucigalpa in Honduras starting in February 2027. The airline says its latest move will expand its international network at the airport to 20 destinations, strengthening its position as a gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean.

These latest additions follow Spirit Airlines' collapse in May , which created substantial opportunities at its former Fort Lauderdale stronghold. JetBlue has moved aggressively to capture displaced demand, with an analysis of Department of Transportation (DOT) data revealing that the airline's international passenger traffic is growing even faster than its added capacity.
JetBlue Adds Two International Routes In February 2027

The first new service will launch on February 23, connecting Fort Lauderdale with Owen Roberts International Airport (GCM) in Grand Cayman. Two days later, JetBlue will begin flying to Palmerola International Airport (XPL) in Comayagua, serving the Honduran capital, Tegucigalpa. Both routes will operate daily using Airbus A220 and A320 family aircraft, with introductory one-way fares starting at $99 and $183, respectively.

The Honduras route will be JetBlue's first service to the Tegucigalpa area, complementing its existing San Pedro Sula operation. Daniel Shurz, JetBlue's Senior Vice President of Network Planning, emphasized the airline's commitment to expanding international connectivity and providing more options for travelers visiting friends and relatives.

"We're grateful for the way customers across South Florida continue to embrace JetBlue, and we're committed to delivering even more of the destinations and travel options they're looking for. With new international service to Honduras and Grand Cayman, we're strengthening Fort Lauderdale's role as a key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean."

Grand Cayman represents a return following JetBlue's short-lived service introduced in December 2025 . The airline will also offer temporary daily flights to Port of Spain between January 29 and February 15 for Trinidad and Tobago's Carnival. Following the recent launch of new routes to Barranquilla and Cali, Colombia , JetBlue expects to exceed 150 daily departures at FLL during winter peaks, its largest schedule ever.
JetBlue's International Capacity At FLL Grows By A Third

JetBlue's international expansion at Fort Lauderdale has been substantial. An analysis of DOT T-100 International Segment data (available through August) shows the airline offered almost 1.7 million international seats in the first eight months of this year, up 33.4% year-on-year. The growth reflects an increasingly diverse network, with new and restored routes complementing established Caribbean and Latin American services.

Much of the additional capacity stems from six international routes launched or restored in December 2025 , including Aruba, Cartagena, Grand Cayman, Liberia, San Pedro Sula, and Sint Maarten. Meanwhile, Guayaquil, Guatemala City, and Santiago have also seen significant growth, showing how JetBlue has strengthened previously limited operations.

However, growth has not been uniform. Montego Bay experienced a 33.9% capacity reduction, while Kingston, Cancún, and Punta Cana also recorded declines. The expansion has also coincided with international route reductions elsewhere in its network . The net result is that JetBlue is not only growing its FLL international network but also diversifying it and concentrating capacity where opportunities are strongest.
Why JetBlue Will Keep Expanding At Fort Lauderdale

Although JetBlue's international expansion at FLL was already underway before Spirit's demise on May 2 , the vacuum left by its former competitor has given it the space to accelerate that growth. To assess performance after Spirit's exit, Simple Flying zoomed in on DOT T-100 data for May-August, compared with the same period last year.

The findings are striking. JetBlue has increased its international seat capacity by 33.0%, yet passenger traffic surged by 45.8%, lifting average load factors from 79.4% to 87.0%, an improvement of 7.6 percentage points. For context, Delta Air Lines averages about 85% load factors on its international routes, and at 87%, Fort Lauderdale is the top-performing base in JetBlue's network.

This clearly demonstrates that JetBlue has not yet reached the limits of demand at Fort Lauderdale, because even as it adds more capacity, it is attracting even more passengers and filling a greater proportion of those seats. And there is the knock-on effect: Growing international passenger volumes also increase ancillary revenues, with JetBlue reporting 20% year-on-year loyalty revenue growth in Q3 2026 , alongside a 55% increase in co-branded credit card acquisitions in South Florida.

A larger international network will certainly reinforce those trends. However, the airline's longer-term success will depend on translating this rapid passenger growth into stronger yields and sustainable commercial returns.
body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍及 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
捷蓝航空周四宣布从劳德代尔堡 - 好莱坞国际机场 (FLL) 开通每日两趟新国际航班，从 2027 年 2 月开始连接南佛罗里达州与大开曼岛和洪都拉斯的特古西加尔巴。该航空公司表示，其最新举措将把机场的国际网络扩展到 20 个目的地，巩固其作为拉丁美洲和加勒比地区门户的地位。
这些最新增加的航班是在精神航空 (Spirit Airlines) 五月份倒闭之后新增的，这为其前劳德代尔堡大本营创造了大量机会。捷蓝航空已积极采取行动来抓住被取代的需求，对运输部 (DOT) 数据的分析显示，该航空公司的国际客运量增长速度甚至超过了其新增运力的增长速度。
捷蓝航空将于 2027 年 2 月新增两条国际航线
第一条新服务将于 2 月 23 日推出，连接劳德代尔堡和大开曼岛的欧文·罗伯茨国际机场 (GCM)。两天后，捷蓝航空将开始飞往科马亚瓜的帕尔梅罗拉国际机场 (XPL)，为洪都拉斯首都特古西加尔巴提供服务。两条航线均将使用空客 A220 和 A320 系列飞机每天运营，单程首发票价分别为 99 美元和 183 美元起。
洪都拉斯航线将是捷蓝航空飞往特古西加尔巴地区的首条航线，补充其现有的圣佩德罗苏拉航线。捷蓝航空网络规划高级副总裁 Daniel Shurz 强调，该航空公司致力于扩大国际连通性，并为探亲访友的旅客提供更多选择。
“我们感谢南佛罗里达州的客户继续接受捷蓝航空，我们致力于为他们提供更多他们想要的目的地和旅行选择。通过飞往洪都拉斯和大开曼岛的新国际航班，我们正在加强劳德代尔堡作为通往拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的重要门户的作用。”
大开曼岛代表着捷蓝航空继 2025 年 12 月推出的短暂服务后的回归。该航空公司还将在 1 月 29 日至 2 月 15 日期间每天提供飞往西班牙港的临时航班，以庆祝特立尼达和多巴哥的狂欢节。继最近开通飞往哥伦比亚巴兰基亚和卡利的新航线后，捷蓝航空预计在冬季高峰期间，FLL 每天的出发航班数量将超过 150 趟，这是其有史以来最大的班次。
捷蓝航空在 FLL 的国际运力增长了三分之一
捷蓝航空在劳德代尔堡的国际扩张规模巨大。对 DOT T-100 国际段数据（截至 8 月）的分析显示，该航空公司在今年前 8 个月提供了近 170 万个国际座位，同比增长 33.4%。这一增长反映出网络日益多样化，新航线和修复航线补充了加勒比和拉丁美洲的现有服务。
大部分新增运力来自 2025 年 12 月开通或恢复的 6 条国际航线，包括阿鲁巴、卡塔赫纳、大开曼、利比里亚、圣佩德罗苏拉和圣马丁。与此同时，瓜亚基尔、危地马拉城和圣地亚哥也出现了显着增长，这表明捷蓝航空如何加强了之前有限的业务。
然而，增长并不均匀。蒙特哥湾的运力下降了 33.9%，金斯顿、坎昆和蓬塔卡纳的运力也出现下降。此次扩张也与该网络其他地区国际航线的减少同时发生。最终结果是，捷蓝航空不仅扩大了其 FLL 国际网络，而且实现了多元化，并将运力集中在机会最充足的地方。
为什么捷蓝航空将在劳德代尔堡继续扩张
尽管捷蓝航空在 5 月 2 日精神航空倒闭之前就已经在 FLL 进行国际扩张，但其前竞争对手留下的真空给了它加速增长的空间。为了评估 Spirit 退出后的表现，Simple Flying 放大了 DOT T-100 5 月至 8 月的数据，与去年同期进行了比较。
研究结果令人震惊。捷蓝航空的国际座位数增加了33.0%，客运量猛增45.8%，平均客座率从79.4%提升至87.0%，提高了7.6个百分点。就背景而言，达美航空国际航线的平均载客率约为 85%，劳德代尔堡为 87%，是捷蓝航空网络中表现最好的基地。
这清楚地表明捷蓝航空尚未达到劳德代尔堡的需求极限，因为即使它增加了运力，它也吸引了更多的乘客并占据了更大比例的座位。这会产生连锁反应：国际客运量的增长也增加了辅助收入，捷蓝航空报告称，2026 年第三季度忠诚度收入同比增长 20%，南佛罗里达州的联名信用卡收购量增长了 55%。
更大的国际网络肯定会强化这些趋势。然而，该航空公司的长期成功将取决于将乘客的快速增长转化为更高的收益和可持续的商业回报。

title_en: Rescue Missions: The Untold History Of The Boeing 747's Unique 5th Engine Mounting
title_zh: 救援任务：波音 747 独特的第五发动机安装的不为人知的历史
summary: Could the Boeing 747 really fly with 5 engines mounted under the wings?
summary_zh: 机翼下装有 5 个发动机的波音 747 真的能飞行吗？
body_en: Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

Picture a legendary widebody aircraft thundering down a runway with five massive powerplants bolted beneath its wings, where only four of them are burning fuel and generating thrust. It may seem like an engineering experiment or a futuristic testbed flight, but this was a real logistical lifeline used during the height of the classic jet age. When a commercial airliner suffered a catastrophic engine failure at a remote airport thousands of miles from home, operators did not wait weeks for maritime freight or transport charters; instead, they simply strapped a spare, fully assembled jet engine directly under the wing and flew it there themselves.

Such an extraordinary capability centered around the Boeing 747's unique fifth-engine mounting system, an engineering marvel designed to rescue stranded airframes when conventional global supply chains failed. Why did Boeing incorporate a dedicated structural hardpoint specifically for hauling dead-weight turbofans across oceans, and how did flight crews manage the immense aerodynamic penalties of a multi-ton pod?
What Happens In The Event Of An Engine Failure On The Ground?

When the 747 entered commercial service in 1970, early high-bypass turbofans like the Pratt & Whitney JT9D and Rolls-Royce RB211 were revolutionary in fuel efficiency but notoriously temperamental compared to today's powerplants. If a widebody suffered a catastrophic engine failure at a remote international outstation, such as a distant hub in Asia, Africa, or the Middle East, airlines were met with a huge logistical problem. Standard cargo aircraft of the era frequently lacked the main-deck cargo door dimensions or payload capacity needed to transport a fully assembled, multi-ton turbofan core across continents.

The incompatibility created crippling Aircraft on Ground (AOG) delays that could strand a flagship aircraft out of service for weeks while awaiting maritime shipping or rare charter flights. To overcome this vulnerability, aviation pioneers drew upon operational precedents established during the dawn of the jet age. Analysis from Simple Flying notes that as early as 1959, Qantas began outfitting its Boeing 707 fleet with external mounting hardware to ferry replacement powerplants across international networks, a resourceful practice later adopted by operators of the Douglas DC-8 as well.

Recognizing that the much larger 747 would encounter identical outstation risks on expanding global routes, Boeing engineered a permanent solution directly into the aircraft's baseline wing architecture. They did so by building a dedicated hardpoint into the port wing so that the Queen of the Skies could act as its own heavy-lift delivery truck.

Mechanically, the fifth-pod system was based on a precision-engineered hardpoint located exclusively on the port wing , positioned inboard between the fuselage and the number two engine pylon. This location was deliberately chosen because it placed the massive secondary weight close to the aircraft centerline, minimizing structural stress on the outer wing spars. Technicians secured the replacement powerplant to a dummy strut designed to withstand extreme shear loads during takeoff, cruise, and landing without distorting the wing's aerodynamic profile.

Unlike the aircraft's active operating engines, the fifth-pod unit was entirely non-functional and carried purely as dead-weight freight. It featured zero plumbing, no fuel feed lines, no electrical wiring, and no hydraulic connections, meaning it contributed nothing to forward propulsion.

In order to prevent catastrophic windmilling and structural bearing damage from oncoming airflow, ground crews removed the forward fan blades or locked them securely, wrapping the core in streamlined aerodynamic fairings and nose-cone caps.

Positioning the multi-ton spare engine close to the fuselage root, engineers minimized dangerous center-of-gravity shifts that could compromise aircraft stability. Despite that, even with the weight efficiently distributed, strapping an exposed turbofan shell under one wing created a significant amount of parasitic drag that massively altered the aircraft's aerodynamic balance.

When an unpowered turbofan is slung beneath the port wing, the resulting parasitic drag creates a persistent yawing tendency that flight crews must actively manage from takeoff to touchdown. The fifth pod sits exclusively on the left side, so the aircraft naturally wants to pull to the left, needing constant rudder deflection and precise trim adjustments to maintain coordinated flight. The reality was that even though the sheer mass of the airframe dealt with much of the disturbance, the asymmetric resistance needed unyielding pilot attention during initial climb phases and crosswind approaches.

To keep the aircraft flying straight and level within safe structural envelopes, flight manuals mandated strict operational limitations, including a maximum cruise speed reduction to around Mach 0.78 or lower to prevent aerodynamic buffeting around the mounting pylon, as noted in discussions from PPRuNe . Furthermore, the added weight of roughly 13,228 lb (6,000 kg) combined with increased drag penalized fuel consumption by 10% to 15%, slashing normal range capabilities.

For multi-thousand-mile rescue operations, this heavy fuel burn resulted in using strategic refueling stops, such as touching down at Perth Airport (PER) before attempting the long Indian Ocean crossing to Johannesburg, as noted in Qantas newsroom breakdowns.

The huge operational penalty made many of these standard delivery routes become carefully choreographed logistical hurdles, which not every airline ended up being able to manage. So which global airlines actually mastered this intricate procedure, and how did they complete the most famous rescue missions of the classic jet era?
The Airlines That Made Engine Ferry Flights Possible

The technical and aerodynamic penalties were, of course, formidable, though only a select group of international legacy operators mastered the fifth-pod procedure. During the classic widebody era of the 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s, airlines such as British Airways, Singapore Airlines, South African Airways, Aer Lingus, and Trans World Airlines kept certified engineering protocols to haul spare engines across their far-flung networks. Among these operators, Qantas emerged as the absolute master of the craft, making use of its geographical isolation at the bottom of the world to perfect fifth-pod logistics across decades of 707 and 747 operations.
body_zh: 航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。

想象一下一架传奇的宽体飞机轰鸣地冲过跑道，机翼下方固定着五个巨大的动力装置，其中只有四个在燃烧燃料并产生推力。这看起来像是一次工程实验或一次未来的试验台飞行，但这是经典喷气机时代鼎盛时期使用的真正的后勤生命线。当一架商用客机在距家乡数千英里的偏远机场遭遇灾难性的发动机故障时，运营商并没有等待数周的时间才获得海运或运输包机；而是立即采取行动。相反，他们只是将一个备用的、完全组装好的喷气发动机直接绑在机翼下方，然后自己飞到那里。
这种非凡的能力以波音 747 独特的第五引擎安装系统为中心，这是一项工程奇迹，旨在在传统的全球供应链出现故障时拯救搁浅的机身。为什么波音公司要采用专门用于跨洋运输自重涡轮风扇发动机的专用结构挂点，以及机组人员如何应对多吨吊舱带来的巨大空气动力损失？
如果地面上发动机发生故障会发生什么？

当 747 于 1970 年进入商业服务时，普惠 JT9D 和劳斯莱斯 RB211 等早期高涵道比涡轮风扇发动机在燃油效率方面具有革命性意义，但与当今的发动机相比，其性能却非常不稳定。如果宽体客机在偏远的国际偏远地区（例如亚洲、非洲或中东的遥远枢纽）遭遇灾难性的发动机故障，航空公司就会遇到巨大的后勤问题。当时的标准货机经常缺乏主甲板货舱门尺寸或有效载荷能力，无法在各大洲运输完全组装的多吨涡轮风扇核心机。
这种不兼容造成了严重的地面飞机（AOG）延误，可能导致旗舰飞机在等待海上运输或罕见的包机期间无法使用数周。为了克服这一弱点，航空先驱们借鉴了喷气机时代初期建立的运营先例。 Simple Flying 的分析指出，早在 1959 年，澳洲航空就开始为其波音 707 机队配备外部安装硬件，以便在国际网络上运送替换动力装置，这种足智多谋的做法后来也被道格拉斯 DC-8 的运营商采用。
波音认识到更大的 747 在扩展全球航线时会遇到相同的外站风险，因此直接在飞机的基线机翼架构中设计了永久性解决方案。为此，他们在左翼建造了一个专用挂载点，以便“天空女王”可以充当自己的重型运输卡车。
在机械方面，第五吊舱系统基于专门位于左翼的精密设计的硬点，位于机身和二号发动机吊架之间的内侧。这个位置是经过精心选择的，因为它将巨大的次要配重放置在靠近飞机中心线的位置，从而最大限度地减少了外翼梁上的结构应力。技术人员将替换动力装置固定在假支柱上，该假支柱旨在承受起飞、巡航和着陆过程中的极端剪切载荷，而不会扭曲机翼的空气动力学轮廓。
与飞机主动运行的发动机不同，第五吊舱单元完全不起作用，纯粹作为自重货物运输。它的特点是零管道、没有燃油供给管线、没有电线、也没有液压连接，这意味着它对向前推进没有任何贡献。
为了防止迎面气流造成灾难性的风车和结构性轴承损坏，地勤人员拆除了前风扇叶片或将其牢固锁定，将核心包裹在流线型空气动力学整流罩和鼻锥盖中。
工程师将重达数吨的备用发动机放置在靠近机身根部的位置，最大限度地减少了可能损害飞机稳定性的危险重心转移。尽管如此，即使重量得到有效分配，将暴露的涡轮风扇外壳绑在机翼下也会产生大量的寄生阻力，从而极大地改变了飞机的空气动力平衡。
当无动力涡轮风扇发动机悬挂在左翼下方时，产生的寄生阻力会产生持续的偏航趋势，机组人员必须积极管理从起飞到接地的整个过程。第五个吊舱专门位于左侧，因此飞机自然会向左拉，需要不断的方向舵偏转和精确的配平调整以保持协调飞行。现实情况是，尽管机身的巨大质量承受了大部分干扰，但在初始爬升阶段和侧风进场时，不对称的阻力需要飞行员集中注意力。
正如 PPRuNe 的讨论中所指出的，为了使飞机在安全结构范围内保持直线和水平飞行，飞行手册规定了严格的操作限制，包括将最大巡航速度降低至 0.78 马赫左右或更低，以防止安装塔周围的空气动力抖振。此外，大约 13,228 磅（6,000 公斤）的重量增加加上阻力的增加，导致燃油消耗减少 10% 至 15%，从而大幅削减了正常航程能力。
对于数千英里的救援行动，这种严重的燃油消耗导致需要使用战略加油站，例如在尝试长途穿越印度洋到达约翰内斯堡之前在珀斯机场 (PER) 着陆，正如澳洲航空新闻编辑室故障中所指出的那样。
巨大的运营损失使得许多标准配送路线成为精心设计的后勤障碍，并非每家航空公司最终都能应对。那么，哪些全球航空公司真正掌握了这一复杂的程序，他们是如何完成经典喷气机时代最著名的救援任务的呢？
使发动机渡轮航班成为可能的航空公司

当然，技术和空气动力学方面的损失是巨大的，尽管只有少数精选的国际传统运营商掌握了第五吊舱程序。在 20 世纪 70 年代、80 年代和 90 年代的经典宽体时代，英国航空、新加坡航空、南非航空、爱尔兰航空和环球航空等航空公司均采用经过认证的工程协议，在其分布广泛的网络中运输备用发动机。在这些运营商中，澳洲航空成为绝对的技术大师，利用其地处世界底部的地理位置，在 707 和 747 数十年的运营中完善了第五吊舱物流。

Aviation Capital Group (ACG) has delivered a Boeing 737 MAX 8 to Norwegian Air Shuttle, the first aircraft in a four-aircraft sale-and-leaseback agreement. The remaining three deliveries are expected through early 2028.

body_en: Cathay Group passenger traffic rises 4% as cargo grows 8% - Aviation24.be

Cathay Pacific and HK Express carried more than 3.4 million passengers in October 2026, up 4% year on year. Cathay Cargo transported over 160,000 tonnes, an increase of 8%, although the group said elevated jet fuel prices remained a concern.

Cathay Pacific’s passenger numbers rose 4% against a 3% increase in capacity, measured in available seat kilometres. The airline attributed demand to China’s Golden Week holiday, Hong Kong’s Chung Yeung Festival weekend and major exhibitions, including the Canton Fair. Passenger numbers for the first ten months of 2026 were 13% higher than a year earlier.

Cargo tonnage grew faster than capacity, which increased by 1%. Cathay said exports from Northeast and Southeast Asia supported growth, including shipments of network equipment and semiconductors. Year-to-date tonnage rose 9%, and an additional Air Hong Kong-operated A330 freighter is due to support selected regional routes.

HK Express carried more than 700,000 passengers, up 3%, while capacity increased 5%. Its load factor reached 77%, with South Korean and Thai routes performing particularly well. Passenger numbers rose 7% over the first ten months.

The group also highlighted its recent order for 11 additional A330-900s and three A321neos . Cathay said committed investment for 2026–2035 now exceeds HK$150 billion , supporting its ambition to take delivery of 150 new aircraft and serve 150 destinations over the next decade, subject to favourable market conditions.

body_en: Aer Lingus unveils first Premium Economy and new A330 business suites - Aviation24.be
Home International Airlines Group (IAG) Aer Lingus Aer Lingus unveils first Premium Economy and new A330 business suites

Aer Lingus will introduce its first Premium Economy cabin as part of a refurbishment of ten Airbus A330s, alongside new Business Class suites and refreshed Economy seating. The first aircraft is scheduled to enter service on 1 October 2027, initially on selected Dublin–New York JFK flights, EI104/EI105.

Premium Economy will have 28 Recaro R4 seats in a 2–3–2 layout across four rows. Seats will offer a 38-inch pitch, eight-inch recline, integrated footrests and privacy wings. Passengers will receive an upgraded three-course meal, complimentary drinks, bedding, an amenity kit and noise-reducing headphones.

The new Business Class cabin will feature 28 Collins Elevation suites in a 1–2–1 configuration , each with direct aisle access and a closing door. Seats will convert into 78-inch fully flat beds, complemented by upgraded bedding. The cabin will also include a self-service snack and refreshment bar.

Economy passengers will receive new ergonomic seats with six-way adjustable headrests, refreshed meals and access to a self-service snack bar. Across all three cabins, Panasonic Astrova entertainment will provide larger 4K screens, Bluetooth headphone connectivity and USB-C charging. Free Starlink Wi-Fi will also be available.

The interiors draw on Irish landscapes and heritage, with bespoke fabrics from Dublin’s Botany Weaving and Ogham-inspired details. Aer Lingus will extend the refurbished product to additional North American routes as more aircraft return to service.

豪华经济舱将设有 28 个 Recaro R4 座位，呈 2-3-2 布局，分布于四排。座椅间距为 38 英寸，倾斜度为 8 英寸，配有一体式脚踏板和隐私翼。乘客将获得升级的三道菜餐、免费饮料、床上用品、洗漱包和降噪耳机。

经济舱乘客将获得带有六向可调头枕的全新人体工学座椅、新鲜餐食以及自助小吃店。在所有三个客舱中，松下 Astrova 娱乐系统将提供更大的 4K 屏幕、蓝牙耳机连接和 USB-C 充电。还将提供免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi。
