body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

JetBlue continues to undergo many changes. Despite this, OAG data shows that the carrier has 892 daily movements (takeoffs and landings combined) in November, up 4% compared to the same month last year.

Benefiting from the end of the now-defunct Spirit, JetBlue's domestic activity has risen by 8% in 12 months, especially at Fort Lauderdale (+57%). In contrast, international service has fallen by 9%. Like with most airlines, various airports have been dropped recently.
JetBlue Has Stopped Flying To These Two US Airports

The carrier's network between January and October 2026 was compared to what's available from November 2026 . This process identified that the following US airports have been removed. They were not served for long. None were significant, at least not to JetBlue. But the airline was important for them.
Initially between January 2016 and January 2019. Returned in December 2025 but pulled out in September 2026
Boston and New York JFK. Boston only had flights in 2025 and 2026
Fort Lauderdale, Fort Myers, New York JFK, Orlando

In the first nine months of 2026, JetBlue had 17% of the flights at Daytona Beach (18% of the seats due to higher-capacity equipment). It also provided the only service from Boston and JFK to the Florida destination. Delta still flies from LaGuardia, but that is it for the Big Apple.

JetBlue had a smaller role at Manchester-Boston Regional Airport, which is by far New Hampshire's busiest facility. Between January and July 2026, JetBlue had 6% of the services but 10% of the seats for sale. However, Manchester no longer has nonstop service to Fort Lauderdale or New York JFK. The short link to JFK was surely partly for slot-sitting purposes , although also for those transiting elsewhere.
JetBlue No Longer Serves These International Destinations

All of these places saw the airline at some point between January and October this year but no longer do so . With JetBlue's exit, only one of the four destinations remains served from New York JFK. That's Antigua, which remains served by American Airlines . Delta Air Lines ended flights in May 2026. However, United Airlines flies from Newark to Antigua, Bonaire, Belize City, and Tulum, although all flights to Tulum will end in January 2027 .

The US Department of Transportation shows that JetBlue transported a total of 91,226 round-trip passengers between New York and Tulum. The load factor was a paltry 70.4%, against 83.2% for the airline's overall network from JFK to Mexico. More than half of the months that had Tulum flights saw fewer than seven in ten seats filled. Fare data is unavailable.

Tulum is located on the eastern coast of the Yucatán Peninsula and has been a growing tourist destination for years. This is despite what seem to be clear problems, such as sewage and very high-priced taxis. Historically, people traveled there via Cancun. But despite the opening of Tulum's airport, ground transport from Cancun appears to be easier than ever.

Let's narrow the focus to November 2026. As mentioned earlier, JetBlue's activity at Fort Lauderdale has jumped by a considerable 57% year-on-year. This development played a critical role in the airline's domestic growth. Other major airports grew much more shallowly or declined, such as Boston (+4%) and JFK (-14%).

JetBlue really benefited from the exit of Spirit at the South Florida airport. Last November, Fort Lauderdale was JetBlue's third most-served airport. Now it is first, also influenced, of course, by the decline at JFK. The growth at Fort Lauderdale was driven by the number of routes jumping from 37 last November to 61 now. On November 19, the airline will begin flying to San Diego .

捷蓝航空继续经历许多变化。尽管如此，OAG 数据显示，该航空公司 11 月份每日起降架次（起飞和降落合计）为 892 架次，比去年同月增长 4%。
受益于现已解散的精神航空的结束，捷蓝航空的国内活动在 12 个月内增长了 8%，尤其是在劳德代尔堡 (+57%)。相比之下，国际服务下降了9%。与大多数航空公司一样，最近有多个机场被取消。
捷蓝航空已停止飞往这两个美国机场的航班

波士顿和纽约肯尼迪机场。波士顿仅在 2025 年和 2026 年有航班
劳德代尔堡、迈尔斯堡、纽约肯尼迪机场、奥兰多
2026 年前 9 个月，捷蓝航空拥有代托纳比奇 17% 的航班（18% 的座位归因于更高容量的设备）。它还提供从波士顿和肯尼迪机场飞往佛罗里达目的地的唯一服务。达美航空仍然有从拉瓜迪亚机场出发的航班，但纽约的航班就这样了。
捷蓝航空在曼彻斯特-波士顿地区机场的作用较小，该机场是迄今为止新罕布什尔州最繁忙的机场。 2026 年 1 月至 7 月期间，捷蓝航空拥有 6% 的服务，但有 10% 的座位可供出售。然而，曼彻斯特不再有飞往劳德代尔堡或纽约肯尼迪机场的直达航班。通往肯尼迪国际机场的短途航线肯定部分是为了抢占座位，当然也为了那些在其他地方转机的人。
捷蓝航空不再为这些国际目的地提供服务
今年 1 月至 10 月期间，所有这些地方都曾经出现过该航空公司的航班，但现在已经不再出现了。随着捷蓝航空的退出，纽约肯尼迪机场仅保留四个目的地之一。那是安提瓜岛，仍然由美国航空公司提供服务。达美航空于 2026 年 5 月结束了航班。然而，联合航空有从纽瓦克飞往安提瓜岛、博内尔岛、伯利兹城和图卢姆的航班，尽管所有飞往图卢姆的航班将于 2027 年 1 月结束。
美国交通部显示，捷蓝航空在纽约和图卢姆之间总共运送了 91,226 名往返乘客。与该航空公司从肯尼迪机场到墨西哥的整个网络的 83.2% 的载客率相比，载客率仅为 70.4%。在图卢姆航班起飞的月份中，有一半以上的座位数不足十分之七。票价数据不可用。
图卢姆位于尤卡坦半岛东海岸，多年来一直是一个不断增长的旅游目的地。尽管存在一些看似明显的问题，例如污水和价格昂贵的出租车，但情况仍然如此。历史上，人们通过坎昆前往那里。尽管图卢姆机场开放，但从坎昆出发的地面交通似乎比以往任何时候都更加便捷。
让我们把焦点集中到 2026 年 11 月。如前所述，捷蓝航空在劳德代尔堡的活动同比增长了 57%。这一发展对该航空公司的国内增长发挥了关键作用。其他主要机场的增长幅度要小得多或有所下降，例如波士顿机场 (+4%) 和肯尼迪机场 (-14%)。
捷蓝航空确实受益于精神航空在南佛罗里达机场的退出。去年 11 月，劳德代尔堡是捷蓝航空第三大服务最多的机场。现在，它首先受到肯尼迪机场衰落的影响，当然也受到了影响。劳德代尔堡的增长是由航线数量从去年 11 月的 37 条增加到现在的 61 条推动的。 11 月 19 日，该航空公司将开始飞往圣地亚哥的航班。

body_en: LATAM unveils A321XLR suites ahead of March 2027 deliveries - Aviation24.be
Home Airbus A320 Family Airbus A320neo LATAM unveils A321XLR suites ahead of March 2027 deliveries

LATAM Airlines Group has unveiled the cabin for its Airbus A321XLR fleet, with 12 private business-class suites and individual entertainment screens throughout the aircraft. Deliveries are scheduled to begin in March 2027. Each aircraft will accommodate 174 passengers, including 36 in extra-legroom Economy seats and 126 in standard Economy.

The Premium Business cabin will feature Thompson Aero Seating’s VantageSOLO suites in a 1–1 layout , giving every passenger direct aisle access. Each suite will have a fully flat bed, privacy door, 19-inch 4K OLED screen, wireless charging and power outlets. The two front-row suites will offer additional space, a 22-inch screen, a private wardrobe and dedicated cabin baggage storage.

Economy will use Recaro R3 seats in a 3–3 configuration, with adjustable headrests, USB-C charging and Bluetooth connectivity. Every seat will have a 13-inch 4K OLED HDR screen, a first for LATAM’s single-aisle fleet. The 36 seats immediately behind business class will provide extra legroom, greater recline and footrests.

A new entertainment system will offer more than 2,300 hours of content and allow passengers to resume programmes watched on previous flights. Wi-Fi will use a multi-orbit electronically steered antenna, with complimentary browsing and messaging available to LATAM Pass members according to their membership tier.

LATAM has committed to more than 10 A321XLRs, which it plans to use to explore new routes and expand its long-haul network. The cabin, developed with design consultancy PriestmanGoode, draws on South American landscapes, colours and materials.

body_en: Avianca offers return flights to stranded Plus Ultra passengers - Aviation24.be

Avianca is offering alternative travel via Bogotá to Plus Ultra passengers stranded by the suspension of the Spanish airline’s Madrid–Buenos Aires and Madrid–Lima routes. Eligible travellers will pay no air fare, although taxes, fees, an administrative charge and other mandatory costs remain payable.

The arrangement covers passengers who have already completed their outbound journey and hold a Plus Ultra return ticket purchased by 17 November , for travel between 18 November and 2 December 2026 . Avianca will verify tickets and allocate seats subject to availability on a first-come, first-served basis.

Passengers must request rebooking at Buenos Aires Ezeiza or Aeroparque, Lima, Madrid or Barcelona airports on their travel date or the preceding day. They must also meet immigration and health requirements for the revised itinerary, including transit through Colombia.

Plus Ultra has suspended its Buenos Aires and Lima services indefinitely, citing financial and operational restructuring and rising costs, particularly fuel. The airline has opened negotiations with creditors and expects to begin a collective redundancy process affecting its Madrid workforce of 679 employees.

The withdrawal comes less than six months after Plus Ultra launched Madrid–Buenos Aires in late May. Operated with Airbus A330s, the route initially ran three times weekly before increasing to five in July.

阿维安卡航空公司 (Avianca) 为因西班牙航空公司马德里 - 布宜诺斯艾利斯和马德里 - 利马航线暂停而滞留的 Plus Ultra 乘客提供经由波哥大的替代旅行。符合条件的旅客无需支付机票费用，但仍需缴纳税费、费用、行政费和其他强制性费用。
该安排适用于已完成出境旅程并持有 11 月 17 日之前购买的 Plus Ultra 回程机票、可于 2026 年 11 月 18 日至 12 月 2 日期间旅行的乘客。阿维安卡航空公司将核实机票并根据先到先得的原则分配座位。
乘客必须在旅行当日或前一天在布宜诺斯艾利斯埃塞萨机场、利马机场、马德里机场或巴塞罗那机场申请重新预订。他们还必须满足修订后行程的移民和健康要求，包括通过哥伦比亚过境。
Plus Ultra 已无限期暂停其布宜诺斯艾利斯和利马服务，理由是财务和运营重组以及成本上升，尤其是燃料成本。该航空公司已与债权人展开谈判，并预计将启动集体裁员程序，影响其马德里 679 名员工。
此次撤回是在 Plus Ultra 于 5 月底推出马德里-布宜诺斯艾利斯航线后不到六个月。该航线由空客 A330 执飞，最初每周运营 3 趟，7 月份增至 5 趟。

title_zh: Volotea 进一步削减法国冬季航班
summary: Volotea is cancelling additional flights across its French network after announcing plans in October to reduce operations by 10–11% to improve profitability. According to Spanish travel publication Preferente, passengers began receiving fresh cancellation noti
summary_zh: Volotea 在 10 月份宣布计划减少 10-11% 的运营以提高利润后，将取消其法国网络上的额外航班
body_en: Volotea makes further winter flight cuts in France - Aviation24.be

Volotea is cancelling additional flights across its French network after announcing plans in October to reduce operations by 10–11% to improve profitability. According to Spanish travel publication Preferente , passengers began receiving fresh cancellation notices on 11 November for services retained in the revised timetable.

At Lille, around 100 further flights have reportedly been cancelled across six routes, bringing the airport’s total winter cancellations to approximately 800. Volotea has also withdrawn 11 flights between Perpignan and Lille, following the earlier cancellation of its Perpignan–Nantes service.

In Bordeaux, the proportion of winter flights cancelled has reportedly risen from 35% to around 40%. Further reductions have also affected Lyon and Rodez. French media cited by Preferente report that Volotea attributes the latest cuts to an accelerated retirement of its Airbus A319s.

The reductions come as the airline undergoes a pre-insolvency restructuring process. Alongside the cuts, Volotea opened a base at Montpellier on 5 November and has allocated two aircraft to Madrid to support its Spanish network, including services to Seville, Málaga, Barcelona, Granada, A Coruña and Córdoba.

Volotea 在 10 月份宣布计划减少 10-11% 的运营以提高盈利能力后，将取消其法国网络的额外航班。据西班牙旅游出版物 Preferente 报道，乘客于 11 月 11 日开始收到新的取消通知，取消修改后的时刻表中保留的服务。
据报道，在里尔，6条航线又取消了约100个航班，使该机场冬季取消的航班总数达到约800个。继早些时候取消佩皮尼昂-南特航班后，Volotea还取消了佩皮尼昂和里尔之间的11个航班。
据报道，在波尔多，冬季航班取消的比例已从 35% 上升至 40% 左右。进一步的削减也影响了里昂和罗德兹。 Preferente 报道援引法国媒体的话说，Volotea 将最新的裁员归因于其空客 A319 飞机的加速退役。
此次削减是在该航空公司经历破产前重组过程之际进行的。除了削减开支外，Volotea 还于 11 月 5 日在蒙彼利埃开设了基地，并向马德里分配了两架飞机，以支持其西班牙网络，包括飞往塞维利亚、马拉加、巴塞罗那、格拉纳达、拉科鲁尼亚和科尔多瓦的航班。

Home Railways Nearly half of Belgian car travellers open to overnight ski trains

Almost half of Belgian travellers who use a car for holidays would consider taking a train, including an overnight service, to a winter sports destination, according to an iVOX survey commissioned by Travelski. The study of 1,000 Belgian travellers found 49% were open to the idea, while 15% said they already sometimes travelled by train for holidays.

Interest in trying an overnight ski train was strongest among younger respondents. Around 40% of under-35s said they would definitely like to try one, compared with 33% of those aged 35–54 and 23% of over-55s.

Price, comfort and practical arrangements remain concerns. Almost a third of under-35s questioned overnight train comfort, while nearly a quarter of respondents under 55 expected rail travel to cost more than driving. Across all age groups, 19% were deterred by the prospect of multiple changes and 22% wanted a car available at their destination.

Travelski is introducing its Night Express from Antwerp and Brussels for winter 2026/27 , with Friday evening departures and Saturday morning arrivals in the French Alps. Return journeys will also run overnight. The company advertises one-way fares from €127 , sleeping accommodation options and space for skis and snowboards.

Its package holidays combine rail travel, seven nights’ accommodation, resort transfers and a ski pass. Travelski says the overnight schedule allows up to eight days in the resort, with selected ski passes extended by one day.

Travelski 委托 iVOX 进行的一项调查显示，近一半在度假时驾车出行的比利时游客会考虑乘坐火车（包括夜间服务）前往冬季运动目的地。对 1,000 名比利时旅行者的研究发现，49% 的人对此持开放态度，而 15% 的人表示，他们有时会乘坐火车度假。
年轻受访者对尝试夜间滑雪列车的兴趣最为强烈。大约 40% 的 35 岁以下人群表示他们肯定愿意尝试一下，而 35-54 岁人群中的这一比例为 33%，55 岁以上人群中的这一比例为 23%。
价格、舒适度和实用安排仍然令人担忧。近三分之一的 35 岁以下受访者对夜间火车舒适度提出质疑，而近四分之一的 55 岁以下受访者预计铁路旅行的成本高于驾车。在所有年龄段中，19% 的人因多重变化的前景而望而却步，22% 的人希望在目的地有一辆汽车。
Travelski 将于 2026/27 年冬季推出从安特卫普和布鲁塞尔出发的夜间快车，周五晚上出发，周六早上抵达法国阿尔卑斯山。回程也将过夜。该公司宣传单程票价 127 欧元起，提供住宿选择以及滑雪板和滑雪板的空间。
其度假套餐包括铁路旅行、七晚住宿、度假村接送和滑雪通行证。 Travelski 表示，过夜时间表最多允许在度假村停留八天，部分滑雪通行证可延长一天。
